jobs.title: Construction Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Join Our Team as a Project Coordinator!

Are you ready to take on a pivotal role in our construction projects? We’re seeking a **Project Coordinator** to join our dynamic team. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast\-paced office environment, coordinating with clients, vendors, and subcontractors to ensure projects are completed on time and to the highest standards.

Key Responsibilities:

* **Pre\-Construction Planning**: Prepare checklists and obtain necessary documents.
* **Permit Acquisition**: Secure city/county permits using our permit runner system.
* **Material Coordination**: Provide clients with material lists based on blueprints and project scope.
* **Subcontractor Management**: Schedule subcontractors, negotiate contracts, and manage payments.
* **Scheduling**: Maintain project schedules in Google Calendar and coordinate vendor timelines.
* **Communication**: Provide daily and weekly (Sunday) updates to clients and maintain constant communication with vendors, customers, project managers, and quality control teams.
* **Quality Control**: Create daily schedules for Field QC and submit/follow up on Requests for Information (RFIs).
* **Financial Oversight**: Approve weekly subcontractor payments and release owner invoices when due.
* **Project Closeout**: Complete end\-of\-project checklists and maintain completion schedules.
* **Daily Reporting**: Fill out end\-of\-day checklists to ensure smooth operations.

Work Schedule:

* Monday to Friday, 7 AM to 4 PM – enjoy your evenings and weekends free!

Qualifications:

* Exceptional organizational and multitasking skills.
* Strong communication and negotiation abilities.
* Proficiency with Google Calendar and standard office software.
* A proactive mindset with a passion for problem\-solving.
* Experience in construction or project coordination is required.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $72,000\.00 \- $84,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Project Coordinator will support the planning, implementation, coordination, and expansion of early wealth\-building initiatives led by the UCLA CalKIDS Institute. Reporting directly to the Principal Investigator and working closely with Institute leadership, the Project Coordinator will serve as the primary liaison between the Institute and a broad network of partners, including community\-based organizations, educational institutions, public agencies, financial capability providers, and statewide coalitions. The primary responsibility of this position will be overseeing the day\-to\-day implementation of the CalKIDS Institute Building Wealth at Tax Time Initiative, a multi\-year effort designed to integrate CalKIDS, 530A ("Trump") Accounts, HOPE Accounts, and other asset\-building opportunities into Volunteer Income Tax Assistance (VITA) and Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC) outreach ecosystems. The Project Coordinator will coordinate and implement partner engagement, training, outreach, data collection, and ongoing communication with participating VITA coalitions and community partners. In addition to supporting the Building Wealth at Tax Time Initiative, the Project Coordinator will contribute to other Institute activities related to early wealth building, including development and dissemination of training resources, stakeholder engagement, research implementation, community outreach, policy initiatives, convenings, and partnerships that advance financial resilience and asset\-building opportunities for low\-income households. The position requires strong project management, relationship\-building, communication, and organizational skills, as well as the ability to manage multiple initiatives and work effectively with diverse stakeholders across California.

At **Toole Design**, we're leading the way in creating safer, more connected communities through sustainable multimodal transportation design. We're a purpose\-driven team of technical experts and operations professionals who believe streets should work for *everyone*. At Toole Design, you'll join a collaborative environment where operations professionals work alongside industry leaders, with mentorship and development opportunities designed to help you grow your expertise.

 **We offer:**

* A collaborative, inclusive culture that supports your growth and advancement
* A flexible hybrid schedule: 3 days in the office and 2 days remotely
* 8 paid holidays; and 16 days of PTO accrual annually
* Competitive salary, excellent benefits, and transportation perks: Benefits and Support
* The opportunity to support projects that improve lives\-advancing safe, inclusive design grounded in ethics, empathy, and equity

As a Project Coordinator, you'll provide project coordination and administrative support that helps our project teams remain organized, accurate, and on schedule. You'll assist with project setup, documentation, compliance tracking, invoicing support, and coordination across multiple departments while ensuring project information is current and complete. Your attention to detail, organization, and service\-oriented approach will help teams deliver successful projects.

 **We are targeting a salary range of $68,000 to $78,000 for this position with flexibility for well\-qualified candidates.**

jobs.title: Brownfields Program Coordinator - West
jobs.description:
Toeroek Associates, Inc. is seeking a **Brownfields Program Coordinator to** coordinate all phases of Targeted Brownfields Assessments in the western U.S. The successful candidate will provide comprehensive coordination of up to ten concurrent Phase I and II Environmental Site Assessments, supporting a team that assesses the nature and extent of contamination at Brownfields sites.


Periodic travel of up to 25% is required. Worksite locations are distributed across the western United States, including Hawaii and Alaska. Candidates must be geographically located within reasonable proximity of West Coast states in order to support operations and facilitate fieldwork.

**Duties include**

* Provide comprehensive coordination of logistics, staffing, reporting, and deliverables across multiple active sites.
* Oversee project managers, including cost estimates, work schedules, and staff assignments to maintain on\-time and on\-budget performance.
* Provide oversight to field staff and subcontractors conducting site investigation and remediation projects for approximately 15 field sites located in the West region.
* Ensure that project deliverables, milestones, and budgets are met.
* Work closely with senior managers in the coordination of work activities to meet milestones, budgetary limits, deadlines, or other performance indicators.
* Communicate professionally and effectively with government customers and project partners.
* Prepare, review, and submit well\-written technical reports in accordance with regulations, applicable guidance and policies, and internal quality control standards.
* Conduct Phase I and II Environmental Site Assessments (ESAs).
* Lead field activities, including soil, groundwater, sediment, and soil gas sample collection; geological logging and interpretation; and oversight of investigation and remediation subcontractors, including laboratories and excavation and drilling companies
* Support providing soil and groundwater assessments, soil gas sampling, asbestos inspections, lead\-based paint assessments, geophysical surveys, and waste determinations
* Prepare technical reports and other documents on topics associated with site characterization, remedial optimization, and remedy implementation
* Recognize technical discrepancies in analytical results and making appropriate corrections following standard procedures
* Provide support in organizing public meetings to address the findings of ESAs

**Required Education/Experience**


BS degree in Engineering, Geology, Environmental Science, or related field with four years of practical experience related to environmental field sampling and two years as a field\-team lead. Preferred work experience with contaminated site characterization and remediation at contaminated sites, including Superfund, Brownfields, or RCRA Corrective Action sites. Strong knowledge of federal and state environmental laws and regulations under Federal (e.g., Superfund, RCRA, Brownfields), state, or other cleanup programs. Experience with Phase I and Phase II ESAs and experience conducting quantitative analyses using Microsoft Excel

**REQUIRED CREDENTIALS/CERTIFICATIONS:**

* 40\-Hour HAZWOPER

**PROFESSIONAL SKILLS:**

* Demonstrated attributes to become a strong consultant team player, eagerness to learn and grow, self\-starter who takes the initiative, versatile, and service\-oriented
* Effective written/verbal communication and organization/analytical skills; experience writing and compiling technical data and reports
* Ability to multitask, maintain flexibility, travel, and work independently with minimal supervision
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities at once


The anticipated hiring salary range for this remote position is $75,000\-140,000 DOQ. Pay consideration is given based on geographic location, relevant work experience, and education. Toeroek offers a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, Life, LTD, STD, and 401 (k). Qualified applicants should include their resume with their completed application for further consideration.


Toeroek Associates is a dynamic small business provider of specialty consulting and analysis services to the U.S. Government. Toeroek offers a collaborative and congenial work environment with a team of passionate staff dedicated to finding solutions to complex problems in the fields of environment, records and knowledge management, and national security. Our multi\-disciplined environmental staff includes scientific, legal, and engineering experts who support federal and state government entities in compliance, removal and remediation, field services, site assessments, oversight, historical and technical research, litigation, cost recovery, and community engagement.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Company Overview:**
The SCGA Junior Golf Foundation’s mission is to develop an inclusive golf community that enables kids to thrive on and beyond the course. Through its programs, SCGA Junior Golf Foundation works to fulfill its mission by creating affordable access to golf for all youth, teaching smart decision\-making skills, on and off the course, and developing a culture of healthy lifestyles. Founded in 1983, SCGA Junior Golf Foundation is the philanthropic arm of the Southern California Golf Association. SCGA Junior Golf Foundation’s programs emphasize both player and youth development by providing a fun, safe, and engaging community for players, parents, and coaches. **Position Summary:**
The Program Coordinator is a full\-time, non\-exempt opportunity assisting with the operation, growth, and exposure of the player \& youth development programs (herein PYD) focused in the community. The Program Coordinator and PYD team implement positive youth development, and golf and athlete development programming, for juniors within the community. The Program Coordinator assists with curriculum development, as well as overall growth and development of youth coaches. The incumbent will be assigned to work at various field locations within the defined geographical boundary and community. This position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, with a starting hourly rate of $24\.00\. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:*** Accountable for the oversight and implementation of all program and safety policies in San Fernando Valley, including program facilitation at Woodley Lakes, Hansem Dam, and Van Nuys golf courses
* Implements positive youth development and team culture building best practices in all aspects of programming and beyond
* Serves as a lead golf instructor at beginner, intermediate and advanced level programming and other events as necessary while promoting best practices regarding safety and SCGA Junior Golf Foundation policies
* Organizes and develops programming/activities/events in accordance with the SCGA Junior Golf Foundation’s mission and PYD program goals and objectives to include those focused on community building.
* Implements and manages program modifications to ensure program goals are achieved.
* Provides supervision, feedback and training on a regular basis to coaches.
* Recruits, schedules and conducts one\-on\-one lessons.
* Administers equipment fittings.
* Develops and maintains community, facility, stakeholder partnerships and relationships for the benefit of the program.
* Assists in identifying and determining outreach organization partners to develop relationship and to better serve organization goals.
* Participates in professional development which may include positive youth development trainings, Titleist Performance Institute, U.S. Kids Golf seminars and professional golf certifications.
* Ensures goals and objectives are met in areas including customer satisfaction, safety, quality and team member performance.
* Assists in the planning of short and long\-term strategies and objectives.
* Collects, records and produces accurate and timely reports of program data.
* Manages attendance, rosters, equipment inventories and data capture related to all programming.
* Creates, maintains and manages all registration pages.
* Other tasks and duties as relevant and assigned.

 **Minimum Skills and Qualifications:*** Bachelor’s degree in related field of study and/or combination of acceptable education and relative work experience.
* In\-depth knowledge of the game of golf; capable of independently leading intermediate to more advanced programming initiatives.
* Minimum of one (1\) year of experience working in sports or events, operations, administrative, and/or other work environment with similar responsibilities.
* Customer service approach with excellent communication and interpersonal skills; outgoing and comfortable in administering small group presentations.
* Demonstrated proficiency in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint presentations.
* Ability to work independently while also effectively interacting and collaborating with other departments and team members to achieve various organizational goals.
* Able to troubleshoot, pivot and adapt to changing situations and environments.
* Conveys a positive demeanor that is professional and approachable at all times.
* Must be able to stand for prolonged periods of time, to include bending/stooping; able to lift and move up to 25 lbs., and occasionally lift and move up to 50 lbs. with minimal assistance.
* Able to work outdoors for extended periods of time and in various elements of weather.
* Flexible schedule; must be available to work evenings and weekends as required.
* Access to reliable transportation and able to travel with timely arrival to assigned working locations as required.

 *The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.* **Equal Employment Opportunity**
The SCGA and SCGA Junior Golf Foundation strongly supports equal employment opportunity for all applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by state or federal law.

**The Simple Luxe Builds \| Norwalk, CA**

The Simple Luxe is a creative services company with two thriving divisions: **Events** and **Builds**. Our tagline says it all: *“we make simple, simply luxurious.”* We transform ordinary gatherings into extraordinary experiences through custom fabrication, event design, and premium installations.

Our Builds division creates **brand activations**, **trade show booths**, **custom furniture**, and **specialty fabrication** for clients nationwide, with a strong base in Los Angeles and Orange County.

You’ll own the sales process from first response through close, working closely with engineering/design and the shop team to scope projects, create proposals, and win orders.

This role is **salary \+ quarterly performance bonuses**.

* Brand activations / experiential builds
* Trade show booths and exhibit builds (including installations)
* Custom furniture builds for the event rental industry (bars, backbars, tables, display units, and specialty builds)
* Custom backdrops (collapsible and non\-collapsible) and specialty installations

Sales Development \& Revenue Generation

* Respond quickly to inbound inquiries, qualify opportunities, and move deals forward
* Proactively identify and outreach to target accounts (agencies, exhibit houses, event rental groups, brand teams)
* Build and maintain a robust pipeline across Los Angeles/Orange County and select nationwide opportunities
* Run discovery calls and client meetings to confirm scope, budget, timeline, and success criteria
* Create proposals, quotes, and pitch materials tailored to each project
* Present solutions and close deals with a consultative, professional approach

* Collaborate with design/fabrication teams to ensure client specifications are met
* Provide accurate quotes based on materials, labor, customization, and shipping requirements
* Ensure clean handoff from sales to production (scope clarity, change orders, timelines)

Market Development

* Research and identify high\-potential industries and clients (event rental, trade shows, brand activations)
* Build relationships with event planners, rental companies, agencies, and corporate event coordinators
* Develop strategic partnerships with complementary service providers

Qualifications

Experience \& Skills

* **3–5 years of B2B sales experience** (events, fabrication, manufacturing, construction, experiential, or related industries strongly preferred)
* Proven ability to manage inbound leads and close custom project work
* Strong written and verbal communication (you’ll be creating proposals and presenting to clients)
* Strong presentation and negotiation skills
* Technical aptitude with the ability to understand fabrication processes, materials, and custom builds
* Organized pipeline management and reliable follow\-through

Tools \& Technical Requirements

* Proficiency with CRM systems and project management tools (**Monday.com experience a plus**)
* Comfortable with Instagram, email, and multi\-channel communication
* Ability to read technical drawings and understand fabrication specifications (preferred)
* Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel locally for client meetings/networking

Personal Attributes

* Highly driven and self\-motivated with an entrepreneurial mindset
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, growing small business environment
* Detail\-oriented with strong organizational and time management abilities

Compensation

* **Base salary: $75,000–$90,000 (DOE)**

Location \& Schedule

* **In\-person role based in Norwalk, CA** (Los Angeles/Orange County area)

Additional Requirements

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator
jobs.description:
The mission of The Los Angeles Cancer Network is to provide unparalleled care to each patient that comes through our doors. We offer individualized treatment using the most recent and relevant proven advances in cancer care, curated with deliberation and compassion. LACN is committed to educating and supporting our patients and their families through every step of the way. We deliver a unique approach for every patient to ensure they receive treatment best suited to their condition, age, and other important factors. We do this by participating in important clinical research, encouraging screenings for early detection, and providing innovative treatment. We are proud to be at the forefront of cancer research through our partnership with OneOncology.


Why Join Us? We are looking for talented and highly\-motivated individuals who demonstrate a natural desire to support the meaningful work of community oncologists and the patients we serve.

**Job Description:**


The **Clinical Research Coordinator** works independently providing study coordination including screening of potential patients for protocol eligibility, presenting non\-medical trial concepts and details, and participating in the informed consent process. Responsible for accurate and timely source documents, data collection, documentation, entry, and reporting including timely response to sponsor queries. Responsible for compiling and reporting on each study including information related to protocol activity, accrual data, workload, and other research information; present this information at regular research staff meetings. May plan and coordinate strategies for increasing patient enrollment, improving efficiency, training of personnel, or identifying new research opportunities. Ensures compliance with all federal and local agencies including the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and local Institutional Review Board (IRB).

**Essential Functions:**


The following reflects management’s definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time with reasonable accommodations.

* Independent study coordination including screening of potential patients for protocol eligibility, presenting non\-medical trial concepts and details to the patients, and participating in the informed consent process.
* Scheduling of patients for research visits and procedures.
* In collaboration with the physician and other medical personnel, documents thoroughly on Case Report Forms (CRFs) the following: changes in patient condition, adverse events, concomitant medication use, protocol compliance, response to study drug.
* Maintains accurate source documents related to all research procedures.
* Responsible for accurate and timely data collection, documentation, entry, and reporting including timely response to sponsor queries.
* Schedules and participates in monitoring and auditing activities.
* Responsible for compiling and reporting on each study including information related to protocol activity, accrual data, workload, and other research information; present this information at regular research staff meetings.
* Notifies direct supervisor about concerns regarding data quality and study conduct.
* Works closely with a regulatory coordinator or directly with the Institutional Review Board (IRB) to submit Adverse Events, Serious Adverse Events, protocol deviations, and Safety Letters in accordance with local and federal guidelines.
* May involve in assisting with patient research billing and reconciliation.
* Ensures compliance with all federal and local agencies including the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and local Institutional Review Board.
* Maintains research practices using Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines.
* Maintains strict patient confidentiality according to HIPAA regulations and applicable law.
* May coordinate training and education of other personnel.
* May participate in centralized activities such as auditing, Standard Operating Procedure development, etc.
* Responsible to plan and coordinate strategies for increasing patient enrollment, and/or improving clinical research efficiency.
* May identify quality and performance improvement opportunities and collaborate with staff in the development of action plans to improve quality.
* May identify new research opportunities and present to investigators
* Participates in required training and education programs.

**Key Competencies:**

* Strong customer service background, preferably in a healthcare setting.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Knowledge of computer/telephone support, preferably in the healthcare industry.
* Ability to resolve customer issues calmly and professionally with diplomacy and tact.

**Education and Experience:**

* BA/BS Degree – Preferred.
* ACRP/SoCRA (or equivalent) certification preferred.

The Assistant Clinical Research Coordinator (ACRC) contributes to the overall operational management of clinical research/trial/study activities from design, set up, conduct, through closeout. The ACRC recognizes and performs necessary tasks to coordinate projects and prioritizes work to meet necessary deadlines. The ACRC participates in planning and organizing necessary tasks to ensure adherence to the study protocol and applicable regulations, such as institutional policy and procedures, FDA Code of Federal Regulations (CFR), and ICH Good Clinical Practice (GCP). jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**


The Membership Sales Representative is responsible for fostering a culture of belonging, health, and connection across YMCA membership and wellness experiences. The Membership Sales Representative serves as a frontline ambassador for the YMCA — welcoming all, connecting members to programs and people, helping them pursue their wellness goals, and driving membership growth and retention. Through relationship\-building, proactive outreach, and exceptional service, this position advances the Y’s mission to strengthen the foundations of community through healthy living and inclusion.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

**Membership Engagement and Belonging**

* Create a welcoming, inclusive, and supportive environment in all YMCA areas by greeting and engaging with members and guests.
* Build meaningful relationships with members to understand their goals and connect them to Y programs, wellness services, and community activities.
* Facilitate small\-group connections to enhance member belonging and long\-term engagement.
* Conduct new member onboarding sessions and wellness consultations to help members set and achieve healthy living goals.
* Respond promptly and courteously to all member inquiries, compliments, and concerns, resolving issues with care and accountability.




**Membership Sales and Retention**

* Actively promote YMCA membership, programs, and services through tours, community outreach, and referral campaigns.
* Conduct prospective member interviews, tours, and follow\-ups — closing with an invitation to join the YMCA.
* Meet or exceed individual and team membership sales and retention goals.
* Implement grassroots and digital outreach strategies to engage local communities and attract new members.
* Conduct member retention calls and exit interviews to strengthen relationships and address barriers to participation.

**Healthy Living Support**

* Support members in achieving health and wellness goals by monitoring progress, offering encouragement, and connecting them to appropriate programs.
* Demonstrate and instruct members in the safe and effective use of fitness equipment and exercise techniques as needed.
* Monitor activity in the fitness center to ensure safety, cleanliness, and a positive environment for all.
* Assist in implementing health education initiatives, fitness challenges, and community wellbeing events.

**Operations and Compliance**

* Accurately process memberships, payments, and registrations while maintaining data integrity.
* Adhere to cash\-handling procedures and maintain confidentiality of member information.
* Uphold YMCA policies related to safety, supervision, mandated reporting, and risk management.
* Participate in staff meetings, trainings, and association\-wide campaigns such as the Annual Support Campaign.
* Model and enforce the YMCA’s Code of Conduct and Core Values of Caring, Respect, Honesty, and Responsibility.

**Leadership**

* Engage with members regarding their participation in YMCA Programs, Annual Support Campaign, and special events.
* Participate in community outreach through grassroots outings, building relationships and partnerships with community leaders, local businesses, and local government.

* **Demonstrate** the Six Pillars of Character (Trustworthiness, Citizenship, Respect, Responsibility, Caring, and Fairness) as well as the YMCA Core Values of caring, respect, honesty and responsibility in all dealings with members, guests, volunteers and fellow staff.
* **Demonstrate** competencies in and willingness to develop in the Cause Driven Leadership areas of mission advancement, collaboration, operational effectiveness and personal growth.

* **Building Relationships:** Connect people to the Y’s cause by developing inclusive relationships, partnerships and collaborations so that Ys can co\-create solutions to pressing social needs

	+ **Competencies Include:** Critical Thinking \& Decision Making, Fiscal Management, Functional Expertise, Innovation, \& Program/Project Management

**Executive Assistant to Founder \& CEO**

**Trauma Law \| Los Angeles, CAFull\-Time \| In Office$85,000 to $150,000, depending on experience**

Trauma Law is looking for an exceptional Executive Assistant to work directly with our Founder and CEO.

This is not an entry\-level administrative position.

We are looking for someone who has supported a CEO, founder, law firm owner, entrepreneur, or other high\-level executive and understands what great executive support actually looks like.

The right person does not wait to be told what to do.

You anticipate. You organize. You protect time. You follow through. You remember the details everyone else forgot. You make sure priorities do not get buried by interruptions.

Most importantly, you make the person you support better.

**THE ROLE**

Your job is to help our Founder operate at the highest possible level.

That means keeping priorities moving, protecting her calendar, preparing her for meetings, organizing information, coordinating follow\-up, eliminating unnecessary distractions, and making sure important commitments do not fall through the cracks.

You will work closely with our Director of Operations and leadership team, but your primary responsibility is the effectiveness of the Founder.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

* Manage a complex and constantly changing executive calendar
* Protect the Founder's time and ensure her schedule reflects the firm's highest priorities
* Prepare daily and weekly executive priority lists

* Manage scheduling, confirmations, changes, travel, reservations, and executive logistics
* Review and organize communications so important issues rise quickly and routine noise does not
* Track commitments made during meetings and conversations and ensure follow\-up occurs
* Coordinate with attorneys, executives, employees, vendors, doctors, experts, referral partners, and other high\-level contacts
* Draft correspondence and organize documents for executive review
* Maintain extreme confidentiality regarding business, employees, clients, finances, and sensitive matters
* Anticipate conflicts and problems before they reach the Founder
* Know what requires the Founder's attention and what does not
* Keep a running list of decisions, priorities, outstanding items, and follow\-ups
* Make sure nothing important disappears because the day got busy

**YOU MAY BE THE RIGHT PERSON IF**

* You have supported a CEO, founder, entrepreneur, managing partner, or senior executive before.
* You are extraordinarily organized.
* You notice details other people miss.
* You have excellent judgment.
* You can walk into a fast\-moving environment and quickly determine what matters most.
* You are comfortable dealing with strong, successful personalities.
* You are confident enough to respectfully say, "You have three things competing for that hour. Which one wins?"
* You are proactive without becoming intrusive.
* You communicate clearly and briefly.
* You follow through relentlessly.

* You are comfortable when priorities change.
* You do not become overwhelmed when ten things happen at once.

**REQUIRED**

* 5\+ years of professional administrative or executive support experience

**THIS ROLE IS PROBABLY NOT FOR YOU IF**

* You need every task assigned to you.

* You are uncomfortable with changing priorities.
* You need a predictable day where everything happens exactly as scheduled.
* You consider calendar management to simply mean accepting meeting invitations.

We are building something significant, and this position will work directly beside the person leading it.

jobs.description:
**Outreach Coordinator (Part\-Time, 20 Hours/Week, Afternoons \& Evenings)** 

Partners4Wellness (P4W) seeks a compassionate and motivated **Outreach Coordinator** to facilitate life\-skills and resiliency workshops for youth involved in the juvenile justice system. This entry\-level position is ideal for recent graduates who are passionate about supporting under\-served youth through mentorship, skill\-building, and community engagement.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

Life Skills and Resiliency Workshops

* Facilitate interactive, evidence\-based life\-skills and resiliency workshops for youth and transitional\-age youth (TAY) ages 16\-25 in Juvenile Hall, the Youth Guidance Center, the Youth Leadership Academy, and other youth\-serving organizations.
* Create a welcoming, respectful, strength\-based, and trauma\-informed group environment.
* Provide guidance, mentorship, and support to participants, helping them develop coping strategies, problem\-solving skills, and goal\-setting techniques.
* Build positive, professional relationships with participants while maintaining appropriate boundaries and modeling effective communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Connect youth to community resources and support services that promote successful reentry.

Curriculum Support

* Maintain and update curriculum materials, participant workbooks, and community resource guides to ensure relevance and alignment with youth needs and best practices.
* Support the enhancement and occasional development of new curriculum content, workshop activities, and resource materials based on program needs.
* Stay updated on trends in youth development, trauma\-informed care, and community resources.

Community Engagement and Collaboration

* Establish rapport and maintain positive relationships with Probation staff, site coordinators, and other programming partners.
* Represent P4W at community and stakeholder meetings to promote life\-skills education for justice\-involved youth.
* Present at conferences on promoting youth mental wellness and resilience.
* Represent P4W at community outreach and tabling events to increase awareness of programs and services.

Program Reporting \& Support

* Track attendance and participation for each session, ensuring timely and accurate data entry.
* Collect youth feedback and support basic program evaluation efforts.
* Share success stories, challenges, and program updates with the Program Manager.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

Education

* Bachelor’s degree in Criminal Justice, Social Work, Psychology, Sociology, Public Health, Education, or a related field required.

**Experience \& Skills**

* Prior experience working or volunteering with at\-risk youth preferred but not required.
* Strong public speaking and group facilitation skills.
* Experience with basic data collection, tracking, and reporting.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Canva.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred.

**Additional Requirements** 

* Work schedule consists primarily of afternoon and evening hours based on program and site needs.
* Following hire, employees will be required to successfully complete a background investigation conducted by the Probation Department to obtain and maintain access to assigned program sites.
* Valid driver's license, reliable transportation, proof of automobile insurance, and documentation establishing identity and employment authorization are required.
* Regular travel to juvenile justice sites required; occasional travel to community locations, conferences, and outreach events as needed.
* Mileage reimbursement provided for approved work\-related travel.

**Compensation: $24\-$25 per hour, depending on qualifications and experience.**

jobs.title: Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**PRODUCTION COORDINATOR**



REPORTS TO: PRODUCTION MANAGER



STATUS: NON\-EXEMPT





**Summary**



Boot Barn is where community comes first. We thrive on togetherness, collaboration, and belonging. We build each other up, listen intently, and implement out\-of\-the\-box ideas. We celebrate new innovations, congratulate one another's achievements, and most importantly support each other.


At Boot Barn, we work together to make a positive impact on the world around us, and by working collectively with encouragement, we consider ourselves “Partners.” With the values of the West guiding us, Boot Barn celebrates heritage, welcomes all, and values each unique Partner within our Boot Barn community.





Our vision is to offer everyone a piece of the American spirit – one handshake at a time.


The Production Coordinator is an entry\-level member of the Creative Production team and is responsible for supporting the day\-to\-day coordination of Boot Barn ecommerce studio photography and production logistics. Reporting to the Production Manager, this role helps keep ecommerce shoots organized, on schedule, and accurately reflected within the team's ecommerce calendar and production systems.


The Production Coordinator will primarily support in\-studio ecommerce photoshoots by maintaining shoot calendars, coordinating schedules, updating production information, communicating changes, and assisting with general studio logistics. This role will also support the Production Manager with travel accommodations, production\-related administrative tasks, and other coordination needs across the department.





The ideal candidate is highly organized, dependable, detail\-oriented, and eager to build a career in creative production. This person should be comfortable working within established processes, managing recurring deadlines, communicating clearly with cross\-functional teams, and supporting a fast\-paced studio environment.


**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**


* Coordinate day\-to\-day scheduling and logistics for ecommerce studio photoshoots.
* Maintain the ecommerce production calendar, ensuring shoot dates, product categories, talent, studio details, and other production information are accurate and current.
* Prepare and communicate daily and weekly shoot schedules, schedule changes, and production details to studio teams and appropriate internal partners.
* Coordinate models, photographers, stylists, studio teams, and other shoot participants, including scheduling and confirmations.
* Partner with Ecommerce, Creative, Photography, Styling, Merchandising, and other teams to gather necessary information and ensure teams are prepared for upcoming shoots.
* Identify missing information, scheduling conflicts, or production needs and follow up with appropriate partners or escalate as needed.
* Support studio production needs before, during, and after ecommerce shoots.
* Coordinate production\-related travel, including airfare, hotels, ground transportation, and itineraries.
* Maintain organized production documentation, shared files, schedules, and vendor and talent contact information.
* Assist with production\-related purchase orders, invoices, receipts, and expense documentation.
* Support the Head of Production with campaign, location, and special project production needs as assigned.
* Demonstrates high level of quality work, attendance and appearance.
* Demonstrates high degree of professionalism in communication, attitude and teamwork with customers, peers and management.
* Adhere to all local, federal and state laws in addition to Company policies, procedures, and practices.
* Performs any other duties that may be assigned by management.


Requirements:
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Communications, Fashion, Photography, or a related field preferred, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 1\-2 years of experience in production, ecommerce, photography, marketing, retail, studio operations, or a related field preferred.
* Previous internship, coordinator, administrative, or studio experience is a plus.
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage recurring deadlines and multiple priorities.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate calendars, schedules, and production information.
* Comfortable working within calendar, scheduling, and project management systems.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to follow established processes and effectively communicate changes or issues to the appropriate partners.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and ability to learn internal production and ecommerce systems.
* Ability to work collaboratively within a fast\-paced studio and creative environment.
* Strong follow\-through and willingness to take ownership of assigned tasks.
* Ability to remain flexible as shoot schedules and production priorities change.
* Interest in ecommerce, photography, fashion, retail, and creative production preferred.
* Ability to work occasional extended hours or support production schedules as business needs require.

**Competencies**

* Organization \& Attention to Detail: Maintains accurate calendars, schedules, documents, and production information while consistently following established processes.
* Communication: Communicates clearly and professionally with internal Partners and external production contacts and shares updates in a timely manner.
* Reliability \& Follow\-Through: Takes ownership of assigned tasks, meets deadlines, and follows through on production needs and outstanding items.
* Adaptability: Responds positively to changing schedules, priorities, and production needs within a fast\-paced environment.
* Collaboration \& Teamwork: Works effectively with the Head of Production and cross\-functional Partners to support efficient ecommerce studio operations.

* Competitive hourly

jobs.description:
Headquartered in the United States, TP\-Link Systems Inc. is a global provider of reliable networking devices and smart home products, consistently ranked as the world’s top provider of Wi\-Fi devices. The company is committed to delivering innovative products that enhance people’s lives through faster, more reliable connectivity. With a commitment to excellence, TP\-Link serves customers in over 170 countries and continues to grow its global footprint.


We believe technology changes the world for the better! At TP\-Link Systems Inc, we are committed to crafting dependable, high\-performance products to connect users worldwide with the wonders of technology.


Embracing professionalism, innovation, excellence, and simplicity, we aim to assist our clients in achieving remarkable global performance and enable consumers to enjoy a seamless, effortless lifestyle.

***Overview***


We are seeking a creative and trend\-savvy **Social Media Content Specialist** to grow brand awareness, engagement, and community presence across Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube Shorts. This role will be responsible for executing day\-to\-day social media activities, managing content calendars, creating engaging short\-form content, and identifying emerging trends that strengthen TP\-Link's connection with consumers.




The ideal candidate combines strong content creation skills with a data\-driven approach to social media marketing. They will develop and publish compelling social content, collaborate with creative teams and influencers, and capitalize on real\-time trends to maximize reach and engagement. Success in this role requires hands\-on experience producing short\-form video content, deep knowledge of social platform best practices, and the ability to balance creative storytelling with measurable business results.

***Responsibilities***

1\. Channel \& Calendar Management  

  

Execute Daily Publishing: Plan, schedule, and publish daily content across Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube Shorts, ensuring every channel remains active, on\-brand, and consistently scheduled.  

  

Content Calendar Strategy: Build and maintain an integrated social content calendar aligned with product launches, promotional campaigns, seasonal moments, and trending topics.  

  

2\. Content Creation \& Production  

  

Agile Content Creation: Shoot and edit native short\-form video (Reels, Shorts) and photo content independently when quick turnaround or real\-time trend capitalization is needed.  

  

Creative Briefing \& Asset Coordination: Draft clear creative briefs and collaborate with internal graphic designers, video editors, and copywriters to produce high\-quality brand assets.  

  

Budget \& Production Management: Manage micro\-budgets for creative production, freelance resources, or sponsored post boosts as required.  

  

3\. Trend Discovery \& Creator Activation  

  

Trend Spotting: Continuously monitor viral audio, formats, memes, and emerging social trends, pitching actionable ideas with a clear hypothesis on why they will perform.  

  

Influencer \& Creator Engagement: Identify relevant tech creators, reviewers, and lifestyle influencers worth activating for content collaborations, product seeding, or co\-branded campaigns.

 **Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree required.
* 3\+ Year of hands\-on experience managing brand social media channels (consumer electronics, hardware, or DTC e\-commerce background strongly preferred).
* Production Skills: Proven ability to shoot, edit, and produce short\-form video content using mobile editing tools (CapCut, Premiere Rush, or native platform editors).
* Platform Mastery: Deep understanding of Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and Facebook formats, algorithms, and performance analytics.
* Creative \& Analytical Mindset: Ability to balance aesthetic storytelling with data\-driven decision\-making to optimize reach, impressions, and engagement rate"

  

**Benefits**  

Salary range: $73,500 \- $100,00 annually


* Fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance (partial premium coverage for dependents)
* Contributions to 401k funds
* Bi\-annual reviews, and annual pay increases
* Health and wellness benefits, including free gym membership
* Quarterly team\-building events


At TP\-Link Systems Inc., we are continually searching for ambitious individuals who are passionate about their work. jobs.title: Influencer Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
#### **Who We Are**


Culture Kings sits at the intersection of music, sport, and fashion. These three pillars are the foundation of our brand and the driving force behind everything we do. At the heart of each is streetwear, which continues to evolve as a defining element of modern culture.

  

We are known for our commitment to exclusivity and excellence, delivering a premium retail experience that transcends genres, cultures, styles, and generations.

  

Every Culture Kings store delivers an electrifying atmosphere unlike any other in retail, with live DJs performing in\-store daily and a space that celebrates creativity and culture. Visited by some of the world’s leading athletes, artists, and tastemakers, Culture Kings remains ahead of the curve, offering a bold and elevated perspective on the ever\-evolving global streetwear landscape.

  

The Role


We're looking for an **Influencer Marketing Specialist** to grow and manage Culture Kings' influencer and content creator partnerships. You'll identify the right voices across streetwear, sneakers, music, sports, and gaming, build genuine relationships with them, and run campaigns end\-to\-end — from first outreach to performance reporting. This role is ideal for someone who's plugged into culture, has a sharp eye for emerging talent and trends, and knows how to turn creator relationships into hype and measurable brand growth. You'll report to the Influencer Marketing Manager and work closely with our Social, Creative, and PR teams.


What You'll Do

* Identify, recruit, and build relationships with micro\-, mid\-tier, and macro\-influencers and content creators across streetwear, sneaker, music, sports, and gaming communities
* Own end\-to\-end campaign execution: outreach, negotiation, briefing, contracting, content approval, and posting schedules
* Manage the influencer gifting, UGC and paid partnerships program, including product selection and mailer coordination for sneaker drops and collab releases
* Track, analyze, and report on campaign performance (reach, engagement, conversion, and ROI), using insights to refine future strategy
* Manage influencer budgets and negotiate rates and usage rights for content
* Build and maintain an organized influencer CRM/database of active and prospective partners
* Coordinate whitelisting, content repurposing, and usage rights for owned social and paid media channels
* Stay ahead of platform trends (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) and surface new creators, athletes, and artists worth partnering with
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Social, Creative, PR, and Retail teams to align influencer activity with product drops, collabs, and in\-store activations
* Represent the brand at sneaker releases, events, and influencer trips as needed


What You Bring

* 2–4 years of experience in influencer marketing, social media, or brand partnerships, ideally in streetwear, sneakers, or lifestyle/entertainment
* A strong network and working knowledge of the influencer landscape across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube
* Excellent relationship\-building, negotiation, and communication skills
* A track record of managing multiple ROI driven campaigns simultaneously with strong organization and follow\-through
* Comfort with performance data — you can read a campaign report and know what to do next
* Experience with influencer marketing platforms (e.g., GRIN) is a plus
* Genuine passion for streetwear, sneaker culture, hip\-hop, and pop culture — you know who's next before they blow up
* Based in or able to work hybrid from the Los Angeles area


Why Culture Kings

* Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits (medical, dental, vision)
* Generous employee discount across the a.k.a. Brands portfolio
* A collaborative, culture\-first team in a fast\-growing streetwear company
* Hybrid flexibility with access to our flagship store and content studio
 **The pay range for this role is:**  

60,000 \- 65,000 USD per year(Costa Mesa)

jobs.title: Legal Project Coordinator (Part-Time 15 hours)
jobs.description:
Join a nonprofit organization dedicated to improving our community through programs that provide equal access to legal services. The Justice \& Diversity Center of The Bar Association of San Francisco (JDC) has an exciting opportunity for a part\-time **Legal Project Coordinator** to be part of the team!

**About JDC**

JDC is a non\-profit organization which provides free legal services through its staff and volunteers to low\-income Bay Area residents. Each year more than 1,600 volunteer attorneys, legal assistants, and law students work with JDC staff to serve nearly 7,500 indigent clients. JDC’s holistic advocacy approach seeks to address the social service and legal needs of clients.

**About the Job** 

The Legal Project Coordinator will work with JDC’s Federal Pro Bono Project, reporting to and working with the Supervising Attorney and Senior Staff Attorney. The Federal Pro Bono Project assists self\-represented litigants in two ways: (1\) staff attorneys at Legal Help Centers in the San Francisco and Oakland federal courthouses provide legal advice and guidance on federal civil cases; and (2\) the Project matches litigants with volunteer attorneys to represent them in their cases.

This is a part\-time position working 15 hours per week. Working hours are flexible so long as they occur during regular workdays and are consistent week\-to\-week. The position is fully remote, but office space is available at JDC’s downtown location should the successful candidate prefer to work some or all of their hours in a more social setting.

As the first point of contact for litigants communicating with the Project, the Coordinator is a critical part of the Project team. The Coordinator’s primary responsibilities are to conduct intakes and screening by phone and email, and to schedule appointments with the Project attorneys when appropriate. The Coordinator uses strong communication and organizational skills to keep the Project’s Legal Help Center legal advice work on track and ensure that litigants eligible for assistance are scheduled in a timely manner. Nestled in San Francisco's Excelsior neighborhood on a nine\-acre campus, the San Francisco Campus for Jewish Living (SFCJL) is the leading senior services organization in Northern California. Our continuum of care includes: the Frank Residences assisted living and memory care; the Jewish Home and Rehabilitation Center, offering long\-term skilled nursing, short\-term rehabilitation, an acute geriatric psychiatric unit for adults over the age of 65; and our Foundation.



Founded in 1871 and formerly known as the Jewish Home, our legacy grounds us as our vision propels us forward. Today, we've evolved to support more than 2,500 older adults each year through innovative, comprehensive programs rooted in the Jewish values of compassion, community, and excellence. We are equally proud of our inclusive culture, where 950 team members of diverse faiths and backgrounds work together in shared purpose.


**WHY WORK WITH US**


* Mission\-driven nonprofit organization
* Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits
* Meaningful work that positively impacts the lives of older adults every day
* Inclusive community, welcoming to all (you do not need to be Jewish to live or work here)

As the Program Coordinator for the Licensed Vocational Nursing (LVN) Program, you will support the planning, coordination, implementation, and daily operations of the program. Working under the direction of the Program Director, you will assist with academic and clinical scheduling, student support, faculty coordination, and clinical partnerships. You will help monitor student attendance, academic progress, and required program documentation while supporting compliance with applicable regulatory and accreditation requirements. This role also participates in program evaluation, continuous quality improvement, student retention, and remediation efforts while promoting a professional and positive learning environment aligned with the mission, goals, and educational standards of the institution.

* Assist with planning, developing, managing, updating, and evaluating all aspects of the LVN Program.

The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, adaptable, and calm under pressure. * Source materials, decor, equipment, and supplies for events while maintaining an organized inventory and positive vendor relationships.
* Serve as a point of contact for clients during planning and execution, providing updates and gathering event requirements.
* Support both daytime catering events and evening venue operations, helping with setup, staffing, and transitions between service styles.
* Capture approved event content for marketing and social media use.

**What We're Looking For**

* Prior experience in event planning, hospitality, or catering.
* Valid driver's license with a clean driving record and reliable personal transportation; will drive both a company vehicle and a personal vehicle for event\-related travel.
* Strong knowledge of food safety and sanitation standards.
* Excellent communication, time management, organizational, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to provide a high level of customer service to clients and guests.
* Experience with event management or catering software (such as Eventbrite or Caterease) is a plus but not required.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and stay flexible as schedules and event needs change.

**The Details**

* Full time, typically 32\-40 hours per week depending on the volume of catering events.
* Compensation range of $26\-$30 per hour.

**Primary Work Location:**

* This is a field\-based, off\-site role. You will travel to catering events and venues throughout the San Francisco Bay Area.
* Reliable personal transportation is required. This role will involve driving both a company vehicle and a personal vehicle for event\-related travel.

**About Us**

At our core, we are driven by a passion for excellence and an appetite for innovation, always reaching beyond expectations to achieve greatness. We are driven by teamwork and a spirit of dedication that empower us to tackle challenges head on, grow through every experience, and thrive together through the power of collective effort.

At Sushi Confidential, we know that every contribution makes a difference. Our work is both challenging and rewarding, offering you the chance to build a thriving career, hone your skills, and explore the boundless possibilities of your potential.

Our team is dedicated, passionate, and faces challenges with energy, determination, and a relentless pursuit of success. We have no limits when it comes to innovation, expansion, and breaking barriers.

We're constantly pushing boundaries, trying new ideas, and exploring bold new paths to bring moments of joy and relaxation to our guests. As part of a team that not only supports one another but also gives back to the communities where we work, we take pride in making a positive impact both inside and outside our walls. Together, we transform meaningful work into unforgettable experiences, for our team, our guests, and our community.

Pay: $26\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour

jobs.description:
The Department of Otolaryngology \- Head \& Neck Surgery is recruiting an Assistant Clinical Research Coordinator (ACRC) for the Childern's Communication Center (CCC).


Under the supervision of a Clinical Research Supervisor, the incumbent will perform entry\-level duties related to the support and coordination of clinical research and outreach activities and may receive training and development to prepare and advance for journey\-level work at the next level within the series.


Duties will include, but will not be limited to the following:


* Assistance with coordination and in\-person participation in on\-site and off\-site CCC clinical research andoutreach activities.
* Telephone survey administration
* Database management and data entry while maintaining data quality
* Review of medical charts and electronic records to extract medical information and other data for use in studies
* Help with the recruitment, enrollment, registration, scheduling, and retention of study participants
* Assistance to research personnel to keep patients on study schedules
* Administrative support for research study activity (including working with the UCSF Committee for Human Research and other regulatory agencies)
* Performance of other duties as assigned

  
**Required Qualifications:**

* HS graduation and sufficient experience and demonstrated skills to successfully perform the assigned duties and responsibilities; and/or equivalent experience/training.
* Computer experience: Microsoft applications, FileMaker pro, REDCap, video and photo editing software
* Demonstrate attention to detail, complete projects on time, prioritize multiple tasks to meet deadlines, collaborate effectively with team members, adapt to changing priorities, and communicate clearly
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 1\-3 years of experience working with children ages 0\-18 years in a classroom or clinical setting
* At least 1 year of experience working with deaf/hard\-of\-hearing children and their families
* Proficiency in a second language (Spanish or Cantonese)
* Fluency in the usage of Committee of Human Research (CHR) online iMEDris system for submission, renewal, and modification of protocols through this system.
* Understanding the patient population to create rapport and a relationship while also giving insight into what is realistic and appropriate for patient participation.
* Experience with electronic medical records.
* Experience with REDCap database structure, maintenance, management and/or creation
* Knowledge of UCSF and departmental policies for dealing with reimbursement, guidelines for research, confidentiality and HIPPA regulations, following the UCSF mission statement and purpose for research, and a clear understanding of policies and procedures on patient safety and confidentiality (electronic and hard copy medical records, patient charts, communication, etc.); knowledge of medical terminology, research policies and guidelines, guidelines for packing/shipping infectious substances, database building/analysis, and data management within some of the following: Access, Stata, SASS/ SPSS, and Teleform programming platforms.
* Knowledge of medical terminology, research policies and guidelines
* Prior experience as a teacher of children with special needs
* Experience applying the following regulations and guidelines:

Good Clinical Practice Guidelines


Health Information and Accountability Act (HIPAA)


The Protection of Human Research Subjects


CHR regulations for recruitment and consent of research subjects


Effective Cash Handling Procedures


Environmental Health and Safety Training


Fire Safety Training


  
**About UCSF**  

The University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) is a leading university dedicated to promoting health worldwide through advanced biomedical research, graduate\-level education in the life sciences and health professions, and excellence in patient care. We are home to five Nobel laureates who have advanced the understanding of cancer, neurodegenerative diseases, aging and stem cells.

In addition to our PRIDE values, UCSF is committed to equity – both in how we deliver care as well as our workforce. We are committed to building a broadly diverse community, nurturing a culture that is welcoming and supportive, and engaging diverse ideas for the provision of culturally competent education, discovery, and patient care. Additional information about UCSF is available here .  

  

Join us to find a rewarding career contributing to improving healthcare worldwide.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, protected veteran status, or other protected status under state or federal law.*

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About PhoenixAI**


PhoenixAI is the Agentic AI Database, purpose\-built to give autonomous AI agents sub\-second access to live enterprise data at massive scale. The platform unifies real\-time and at\-rest data in a single AI\-native engine, combining the speed and concurrency that agentic workloads demand with the governance and deployment flexibility enterprises require to put AI into production. Formerly known as CelerData, PhoenixAI is headquartered in Menlo Park, California. Learn more at phoenixdata.ai **About the role**


PhoenixAI is looking for an experienced Field Marketing Manager to own our in\-person event programs end\-to\-end. This is a senior, hands\-on role for someone who has already managed high\-stakes events at a tech startup — ideally in the data, infrastructure, or SaaS space — and understands how to allocate resources, manage vendors, and drive measurable outcomes.  

Events are a key growth channel for PhoenixAI. The current program includes a monthly technical meetup (in the Bay Area and other U.S. cities), quarterly executive receptions for key customers, and a presence at major industry conferences such as AWS re:Invent. Our events motion is anchored in the StarRocks open\-source community, and this role works closely with DevRel and Community to turn that community into a recurring, high\-quality in\-person program. This person will define clear goals for each program, execute flawlessly, and report results back to the business. **What you'll do**


The Field Marketing Manager will own the full lifecycle of PhoenixAI's in\-person events — strategy, budget, execution, and reporting — working cross\-functionally to bring the right people and content into each program.* Take full ownership of meetups, conferences, customer receptions, and partner programs from concept to close\-out.
* Build and run a monthly technical meetup program in the Bay Area and other cities, drawing speakers and co\-hosts from the StarRocks community, customers, and partners, in close coordination with DevRel.
* Plan and host quarterly executive receptions for key customers in partnership with Sales and Customer Success, focused on relationship depth, expansion, and advocacy.
* Lead PhoenixAI's presence at major industry conferences and partner events (e.g., AWS re:Invent) — sponsorship selection, booth, speaking opportunities, and on\-site execution.
* Leverage the open\-source data ecosystem — community members, other project communities, local meetup organizers — to source speakers, co\-hosts, and venues for our events.
* Define the specific objective for each event before it happens — e.g., lead generation, pipeline influence, brand awareness, or customer engagement — and design the event and its metrics around that goal.
* Handle venue selection, sponsorship arrangements, vendor relationships, catering, booth setup, signage, promotional items, shipping, and travel logistics.
* Develop event schedules and keep colleagues, speakers, partners, and vendors aligned and on track.
* Produce landing pages, invites, social content, email outreach, and other materials to promote events.
* Work with speakers on presentations, demos, and run\-of\-show planning.
* Bring in internal technical resources — such as Product Management, Solutions Architects, and Engineering — to support event content and demos where needed.
* Partner with Sales ahead of each event to define target accounts, meeting objectives, and follow\-up plans.
* Make sure leads gathered at events are logged accurately and passed along to Sales without delay.
* Capture and repurpose event content — recordings, photos, speaker decks — with the content and social teams.
* Coordinate with the team that owns webinars to align calendars and cross\-promote where in\-person and virtual programs overlap.
* Track and report on performance against the stated goal for each event (MQLs/SQLs generated, pipeline influence, awareness metrics, community growth, customer engagement, or similar).
* Keep an up\-to\-date calendar of upcoming conferences, sponsorship options, and community gatherings.

**Qualifications**

* 5\+ years of field or event marketing experience at a fast\-growing tech startup, ideally in the data, infrastructure, or SaaS space.
* Proven experience organizing events for an open\-source or developer community — running meetups, community days, contributor gatherings, or community tracks at conferences. This is required.
* An existing network in the open\-source data ecosystem (e.g., StarRocks, Apache projects, Linux Foundation events, or the broader data engineering community) that you can draw on for speakers, co\-hosts, and venues is strongly preferred.
* Track record of running events end\-to\-end in a fast\-moving, resource\-constrained environment, from large conference sponsorships to small executive hospitality events.
* Demonstrated ability to work cross\-functionally with internal technical stakeholders such as Solutions Architects, Product Managers, and DevRel.
* Strong vendor and budget management skills.
* Familiarity with event and community tooling (e.g., Luma, Bevy, Splash) and marketing automation / CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce).
* Comfortable engaging with technical speakers, partners, prospective customers, sales, and executive leadership.
* Willingness to travel for events and work evenings/weekends as needed around event schedules.
* Must currently be based in the San Francisco Bay Area.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  

When applying, please include 2–3 community or field events you have organized and your role in each.  

The base salary for this role is projected at $150,000 \- $200,000, plus eligibility for PhoenixAI's bonus and equity programs. Individual compensation will be determined based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic

jobs.title: Field Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About LiveKit**
-----------------

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the voice\-driven era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice AI applications for OpenAI, xAI, Salesforce, Coursera, Spotify, and thousands of others, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

**About This Role**
-------------------


Most companies that sell to developers treat events like a booth and a badge scanner. We don't. Field marketing at LiveKit exists to do one thing: put the right builders and buyers in a room, and turn that into pipeline. Over the past year we've shipped 35\+ events — dinners, meetups, conference activations — and the playbook works. Now we're hiring the person who runs it day to day. To be clear about the tradeoff: this is an execution\-heavy role. Venues, vendors, budgets, swag logistics, and follow\-up lists that actually reach sales within 48 hours. If you want to watch from the strategy deck, this isn't it. If you want to own real events end to end from week one — at the exact moment the team is scaling — keep reading.


You'll thrive as a Field Marketing Coordinator if you:

* are obsessed with making the best product for our customers
* are known as the go\-to person for tackling tough problems
* work hard and can build and ship fast
* are focused on polish, detail and quality
* are a fast learner, frequently picking up new tips, tricks, and skills


The best way to impress us is with thoughtful ways you'd support LiveKit’s GTM plan.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own end\-to\-end logistics for regional field events — dinners, meetups, and conference activations — including venue sourcing, vendor management, procurement, and on\-site execution
* Run the pre\- and post\-event sales enablement motion: attendee list hygiene, sales handoff, and follow\-up tracking within 48 hours of every event
* Track event KPIs and clearly communicate results to Sales, Marketing, and Finance
* Manage the swag and event inventory program — sourcing, warehousing, and ordering
* Provide executional support on ABM and Demand Gen campaigns where needed

**Who You Are**
---------------

* Able to travel for events across the US
* 2–4 years in event coordination, field marketing, or a comparable event\-heavy role
* Results\-oriented — you track, report, and can articulate what an event actually produced
* Strong at vendor and logistics management, and comfortable owning budgets and procurement details
* Comfortable using AI and marketing tooling to increase your output
* Able to operate independently in a fast, ambiguous environment

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* You've run events tied to a sales pipeline goal, not just general brand awareness
* B2B, dev\-tools, or infrastructure company background
* HubSpot or similar marketing automation experience
* You've personally hauled a box of swag through an airport — and would do it again

**Our Commitment to You**
-------------------------

* An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world
* Contribute to open source alongside world\-class engineers
* Competitive salary and equity package
* Health, dental, and vision benefits
* Flexible vacation policy


LiveKit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@livekit.io.


Compensation Range: $102K \- $138K

* Experience as a developer and/or support escalation team member for large enterprise customers or service providers.

* Company\-issued equipment
* Formal, hands\-on training


Role Responsibilities
  
  

**The responsibilities of the role will include:**  

* Working directly with clients as a primary point of contact for day to day account support, problem resolution, technical clarity, research and analysis
* Responding to inbound emails, fax, and phone calls, and Salesforce cases
* Developing and executing a client service delivery strategy for assigned clients around the needs, contracts specifications and cost components
* Conducting regularly scheduled calls, presentations to review business performance, including training and education
* Making decisions regarding the set up and support of the clients assigned to their care
* Preparing and presenting solutions in advance to retain relationships
* Using customer feedback to monitor the status of service levels, identifies problems and revenue growth potential within the client base
* Effectively interacting with internal departments to support customer base
* Trouble\-shooting of client\-raised servicing issues to determine if the issue is a system issue, training issue, or client configuration.


Qualifications \& Skills
  
* Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent work experience required.
* One to two years’ work experience with customer servicing responsibility.
* Must be able to manage time effectively and work independently without direct supervision
* Excellent level of personal organization with superior telephone etiquette, verbal and written communication skills, as well as, customer service skills are required
* Ability to react quickly and decisively to resolve customer issues
* Demonstrated ability to work calmly in a fast\-paced team environment while effectively managing multiple projects
* Self\-driven to develop professionally, improve performance, and understand the tools in place and maximize their use.
* Demonstrates leadership qualities that influence peers to work collaboratively, automate manual processes, and use the systems available to their fullest potential.
* Serves as key contributor in developing and testing new processes and procedures that enhance the users experience.
* Acts as change agent as appropriate.


Benefits \& Perks
  
* Medical, Dental \& Vision benefits available the 1st month after hire
* Automatic enrollment into our 401k plan (subject to eligibility requirements)
* Virtual fitness classes offered company\-wide
* Robust PTO offerings including: major holidays, vacation, sick, personal, \& volunteer time
* Employee discounts with major providers (i.e. wireless, gym, car rental, etc.)
* Philanthropic support with both local and national organizations
* Fun culture with company\-wide contests and prizes


Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer
  
CORPAY is an Equal Opportunity Employer. CORPAY provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, gender (including pregnancy), religion, national origin, ancestry, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, language, ancestry, genetic information, veteran and/or military status or any other group status protected by federal or local law. If you require reasonable accommodation for the application and/or interview process, please notify a representative of the Human Resources Department.

jobs.description:
Overview:

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our \~16,800 employees create world\-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.  

Our award\-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry\-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.
Responsibilities:
**Key Requirements:*** Develop and execute account strategies to achieve revenue and growth objectives.
* Build trusted relationships with engineering, technical, procurement, and executive stakeholders.
* Identify new business opportunities and expand Keysight’s presence within existing and prospective accounts.
* Develop sales opportunities from initial customer engagement through proposal, negotiation, and order closure.
* Understand customer technology roadmaps and align Keysight solutions with their business and technical requirements.
* Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipeline visibility, and account plans.
* Work closely with Industry Solution Team, Solution Engineers, Business Development, Inside Sales, and other Keysight resources.
* Conduct customer meetings, presentations, demonstrations, and business reviews.
* Develop relationships at multiple levels within customer organizations.
* Identify opportunities for cross\-selling and expanding Keysight’s portfolio across customer organizations.
* Stay current on semiconductor, AI, networking, data center, wireless, optical, and other emerging technology trends.
* Negotiate commercially while balancing customer value, competitive positioning, and Keysight’s business objectives.
* Build long\-term customer relationships and establish Keysight as a strategic technology partner.


Qualifications:
**Required:*** Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Demonstrated ability to develop customer relationships and identify business opportunities.
* Strong interest in technology and the ability to learn complex technical concepts.
* Self\-motivated, entrepreneurial, and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to manage multiple opportunities and prioritize activities based on business impact.

**Preferred:*** 2\+ years of sales, account management, business development, or technical customer\-facing experience.
* Experience with semiconductor, AI, networking, data center, optical communications, photonics, or electronic test and measurement technologies.
