### **Job Title**

Sales, Key Account Manager \- Mobile Surgery (Northern CA and Nevada)
### **Job Description**

As the Mobile Surgery Key Account Manager (MoS KAM), you will be the primary point of contact for Mobile Surgery decision makers both inside and outside of the hospital. Primarily responsible for Mobile Surgery C\-Arms and Services; identify, develop, and close MoS opportunities in Philips installed, competitive installed, and new construction labs and operating rooms.


**Your role:**

* You will also work collaboratively with our Cardiovascular Fixed System Account Managers, Interventional Guided Therapy Devices (IGT\-D), Cardiovascular Ultrasound (CV Ultrasound), Enterprise Diagnostic Informatics in Cardiology (EDI Cardiology) and our Out of Hospital Business Development Manager teammates. You will work closely with your account manager counterparts in Precision Diagnosis (CT, MRI, DXR) and Connected Care Patient Monitoring along with Account Executives, Specialists, Services and Solutions
* Establish territory growth plans and strategic initiatives and translate them into clear objectives and targets. AND with a strong knowledge of competitive landscape, such as business models, product features, service offerings, and positioning you will develop and continually refine business strategy for key accounts, customers, and territory to achieve sales targets.
* Document territory install base related to the solutions represented, establish plan to address all assigned accounts within the territory to include breakthrough competitive accounts, segment strategy and understand the market potential of your territory
* Drive sales process by uncovering compelling customer events, engaging stakeholders, developing coaches, executing C\-Arm demos and escalating as appropriate.
* Establish and maintain effective relationships that build trust with external and internal customers with emphasis on delivering customer\-centric solutions through understanding of customer needs/pain points.

* 5\+ years of Medical Device Sales experience selling directly into the OR. Capital equipment highly preferred and selling into Radiology also preferred.

* You have a BS/BA Degree in related discipline, or equivalent experience.
* You must be able to successfully perform the following minimum Physical, Cognitive and Environmental job requirements with or without accommodation for this Sales position.

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office\-based teams, this means working in\-person at least 3 days per week. San Francisco; New York


**Employment Type**
-------------------


Full time


**Location Type**
-----------------


Remote


**Department**
--------------


GTM


**Compensation**
----------------


* $300K • Offers Equity

  
**About Us:**
-------------


**AI needs a new infrastructure layer. We're building it at Modal.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.


Our customers include category\-defining companies like Lovable, Ramp, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub\-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low\-latency inference, fine\-tune models, and access production\-ready sandboxes at scale.


We recently raised a $355M Series C at a $4\.65B valuation, led by General Catalyst and Redpoint Ventures. We've crossed $300M\+ ARR and grown fivefold since September.


Our team includes creators of popular open\-source projects (e.g., Seaborn, Luig**i**), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders


**About the Role**
------------------


We're hiring the first Account Managers at Modal. You'll report to the Regional Director of Account Management and be a founding member of the team.


This function does not exist yet. There is no playbook, no territory map, no established motion. You'll own a book of business from day one and build the motion at the same time — from fast\-moving AI startups to large enterprise teams running critical infrastructure on Modal.


This is a commercial role with a revenue target. You'll be measured on retention and expansion across your accounts. While you won't be delivering the technical recommendations and implementation, the work is technical by nature. Our customers are engineers running GPU workloads, inference, and batch jobs in production, and you need to hold your own in those conversations.


The profile we're hiring is a technical account manager. You've worked at companies that are deeply technical and consumption in nature. You bring the commercial instincts to grow revenue from an existing base and enough technical depth to know which conversation actually matters. And you can credibly work with a CxO all the way down to a Developer.


**What the Role Is**
--------------------


* **A founding seat.** You're helping build the AM function with us, not joining one that already runs. The account plans, expansion motions, and customer cadence you and the rest of the founding team figure out are what we scale to every AM we hire after you.
* **A technical customer\-facing role.** You'll work directly with Developers and ML teams on what they're building and how Modal fits. You translate and triage the deeper technical work to FDEs and Product when it's needed.
* **A book of business.** You’ll own a set of accounts and be responsible for the revenue that comes from them. Expect to be meeting with customers in your first few days because the best playbooks are built from real experiences.

**What the Role Is Not**
------------------------


* **A traditional post\-sales role.** You're measured on revenue, not health scores.
* **An on\-call support function.** You're not fixing bugs or triaging tickets. You're driving growth.
* **A technical delivery role.** You're not implementing for the customer. You know where the technical work goes and you pull in the right people.
* **An inherited motion.** Nothing is handed to you. If you identify gaps in process, tooling, or a playbook — you help build it.
* **A single\-lane job.** Our priorities go customer company team me. We focus on delivering maximum impact vs. "this is my job".

**What You'll Achieve**
-----------------------


* Build Modal's account management function and iterate on it as we scale the business
* Own and deliver on a revenue target across your book of accounts
* Grow an account's first use case, expand into a second, and drive standardization across the Modal platform
* Get fluent enough in Modal to hold your own with engineering teams on their workloads, and know when to pull in FDEs, Support, or Product
* Work with Sales, Solutions Architects, FDEs, Support, and Product to grow accounts and feed customer signal back into the roadmap
* Travel to customers as needed to support key accounts and drive expansion opportunities

**What You'll Need to Bring**
-----------------------------


* **Customer\-facing experience.** You've owned a revenue target or supported a revenue target in a highly technical, consumption business.
* **Technical depth.** You work autonomously with Developers through CxOs and understand the core parts of the developer tech stack.
* **AI builder.** You're hands on building with AI tools — not just consuming workflows that were built for you.
* **Ownership.** You run your book of business and projects like you're the CEO of it. You're highly organized bringing stability, predictability, and pace to your work. You take action vs. waiting for direction.
* **Learning velocity.** You operate with the mindset of what I can do today vs. let me pick this up tomorrow. You move fast, take the learnings, and iterate on it.
* **Cross\-functional partner.** Low ego, easy to work with, and highly accountable. You ask for feedback, you act on it, and you'd rather be corrected early than right late. Internal teams love working with you.

**Nice to Haves**
-----------------


* Experience as a Technical Account Manager, Solutions Engineer, Solutions Consultant, or similar type role
* Certification as an engineer (ex. Computer Science Degree, Professiona

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
==============



Concert Health is the leading national behavioral health medical group committed to integrating the Collaborative Care model into existing health care practices to improve patients' lives. We believe everyone, regardless of location or insurance, should have easy access to personalized, high\-quality behavioral health support that is guided by the provider they trust.


### **Who You Are**



You are a seasoned account leader who is energized by depth over breadth — you'd rather go deep on a smaller portfolio of complex, high\-value accounts than manage a wide book with less context on each. You build real fluency in each partner's clinical operations, stakeholders, and goals, and you use that fluency as the foundation for everything else: faster issue resolution, sharper growth strategy, and smoother provider onboarding.



You're equally comfortable being hands\-on and thinking several moves ahead. Day to day, you're the named point of contact partners trust to resolve issues and keep commitments on track. At the same time, you're building the data\-backed case for why a partner should expand, and running the onboarding plan for the next provider joining the account — moving between all three without losing sight of the relationship that ties them together.



You bring the judgment and track record of someone with 9\+ years in Account Management, Customer Success, or Client Services in healthcare, with a career trajectory into progressively larger and more complex accounts. You've driven measurable growth in existing accounts (not just retention), ideally onboarded new sites, providers, or users into a live account, and you're credible in a room with C\-suite and senior clinical leadership. Beyond your own accounts, other Account Managers look to you for how the job should be done — you set the standard, not just meet it.


### **Job Summary**



The Key Account Manager owns the complete lifecycle of Concert Health's most strategic partnerships — day\-to\-day relationship management, long\-term account growth, and the onboarding of new providers within existing accounts. This is Concert Health's most advanced individual\-contributor role in Account Management: one person, accountable end\-to\-end for a focused portfolio of high\-value, high\-complexity accounts, trusted to move fluidly between hands\-on servicing, strategic growth planning, and program\-managed provider launches without ever dropping the relationship thread.


**Core Responsibilities:**


*Own Day\-to\-Day Partner Success \& Issue Resolution:*


* Serve as the primary, named point of contact for a focused portfolio of key accounts, ensuring timely, high\-quality responses across clinical, operational, and administrative needs
* Proactively identify, triage, and resolve issues – driving toward systematic, scalable solutions rather than one\-off fixes
* Coordinate cross\-functional resources (clinical, operations, product, billing) to remove barriers and maintain momentum within each account
* Establish clear accountability, follow\-through, and communication loops so nothing falls through the cracks for your accounts
* Maintain deep, current fluency in each key account's clinical operations, stakeholders, and performance, so day\-to\-day servicing and long\-term strategy are always working from the same picture


*Grow Key Accounts*


* Own overall account performance for your portfolio – clinical, operational, and financial – with direct accountability for growth, not just retention
* Use utilization, outcomes, and financial data to identify white\-space opportunities within each key account and translate them into a concrete growth plan
* Build and pitch data\-backed growth and expansion cases to partner leadership, framing clinical outcomes and financial performance into a compelling case for investment
* Translate partner goals into actionable success plans with clear milestones and measurable outcomes, and hold both internal teams and partners accountable to them
* Lead negotiations with partner stakeholders to convert growth opportunities into signed, executed expansion


*Manage Leadership \& Executive Relationships*


* Build and maintain strong, trust\-based relationships with executive sponsors and senior clinical stakeholders at each key account
* Lead regular business reviews, presenting performance insights, outcomes, and growth recommendations
* Confidently navigate complex, matrixed stakeholder environments, aligning priorities and driving decision\-making
* Act as a strategic advisor, influencing partner leadership to invest in and expand Collaborative Care as a core model across their organization


*Set the Standard for the Function*


* Serve as a thought partner and mentor across the Account Management team, setting the bar for how account growth and provider onboarding should be done
* Define and codify the playbooks, frameworks, and best practices that other Account Managers are trained on
* Represent the voice of key accounts in product and clinical program roadmap discussions, with the credibility to shape how those roadmaps are prioritized
* Operate with a high degree of autonomy, ownership, and urgency – anticipating challenges before they arise and acting decisively to keep accounts on track


**Qualifications:**


* 9\+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, or Client Services, with a demonstrated trajectory into progressively larger and more complex accounts
* Healthcare experience required
* Demonstrated success balancing hands\-on day\-to\-day account servicing with longer\-term strategic growth planning
* Proven track record driving measurable expansion or growth revenue within existing accounts, not just retention
* Experience onboarding or implementing new sites, providers, or users within an existing customer account preferred
* Strong foundational understanding of the healthcare delivery system in primary care and administrative/

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support, Strategic Industries
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. jobs.description:
Latitude Wines is an alcoholic beverage import and distribution company that specializes in wine and spirits. The company serves national and regional wine and spirit retailers, importing products from Europe, South America, and Australia and distributing nationally across the US.

The Logistics Coordinator supports the Domestic Distribution and Logistics Manager in executing the day\-to\-day movement of LWX product across the domestic and international supply chain. As part of a small, collaborative logistics team, this role tracks inbound containers and outbound shipments, keeps orders moving on schedule, reconciles warehouse inventory, and partners closely with third party carriers, warehouses, and internal teams to ensure accurate, on\-time delivery.

Includes the following; other duties may be assigned.

**Support Transportation Operations**

· Track shipments from booking through delivery

· Monitor arrivals, clearance, and free\-time deadlines to avoid demurrage and detention

· Schedule pickups, delivery and receiving appointments with forwarders, carriers, and warehouses

· Maintain accurate shipment milestones and documentation in the ERP and tracking tools

**Support Warehouse Operations**

· Reconcile warehouse and 3PL inventory against ERP records and resolve discrepancies

· Support cycle counts, physical inventories, and adjustment documentation

· Verify receipts, transfers, and shipment confirmations are posted accurately and on time

· Track damages, shortages, and overages and coordinate claims with warehouses and carriers

· Monitor partners against service level expectations and follow up on corrective actions

· Track freight, storage, and accessorial costs against contracted rates and identify savings opportunities

· Recommend routing, consolidation, and scheduling improvements that reduce cost without reducing service

· Contribute to reporting and dashboards on logistics service, cost, and partner performance

**Key Performance Indicators**

· On\-time shipment and delivery performance

· Inventory accuracy and timely resolution of warehouse discrepancies

**Supervisory Duties**

· This role has no direct reports and operates under the direction of Domestic Distribution and Logistics Manager

**Competencies**

· Highly organized and detail\-oriented; manages competing priorities and deadlines

· Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills

· Clear communicator with consistent follow\-up, internally and externally

· Collaborative team player who flexes as business needs change

· Continuous\-improvement and service\-oriented mindset

**Qualifications**

· Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Operations, or a related field, or equivalent experience

The CUNY Fatherhood Academy (CFA) is a comprehensive program designed to promote responsible parenting and to foster economic stability for unemployed and underemployed young fathers through education, employment, and personal development. For 175 years, NYU Grossman School of Medicine has trained thousands of physicians and scientists who have helped to shape the course of medical history and enrich the lives of countless people. An integral part of NYU Langone Health, the Grossman School of Medicine at its core is committed to improving the human condition through medical education, scientific research, and direct patient care. **Position Summary:**

Using longitudinal neuroimaging, plasma proteomics, and detailed clinical assessments of a prospective cohort, the study examines how hormonal changes and menopausal hormone therapy influence brain aging and cognitive outcomes. The goal is to define sex\-specific biomarkers and risk profiles that support earlier detection, more precise prevention, and clinically meaningful strategies to protect women's health across midlife and aging.

The chapter is committed to design excellence, public outreach, and professional development. The Center for Architecture, inaugurated in 2003 as the first cultural institution within the AIA network, aims to be the premier hub for learning about architecture and urbanism in New York City. Through various programs and events, it fosters engagement among architects, professionals, and the public. Both AIA New York and the Center for Architecture advocate for the importance of design in enhancing urban life. Experienced in handling a wide range of administrative duties and executive support\-related tasks and able to work independently with little or no supervision. Well organized, flexible, and enjoys the challenges of supporting an office of diverse people.

*Calendar, Space, and Operations Management (30%):*

jobs.title: Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
iHeartMedia  



Current employees and contingent workers click here **to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.**

  



The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it! iHeartMedia, **the number one audio company in America**, reaches 90% of Americans every month \- a monthly audience that’s **twice the size of any other audio company** – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad\-supported music streaming service. In fact, we have:

* **More \#1 rated markets** than the next two largest radio companies combined;
* **We’re the largest podcast publisher**, with more monthly downloads than the second\- and third\-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest\-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;
* iHeart is **the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on\-air personalities and podcast influencers**, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;
* We create and produce some of **the most popular and well\-known branded live music events** in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;
* iHeartRadio is the **\#1 streaming radio digital service** in America;
* Our **social media footprint** is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and
* We have **the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio**, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale. As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option.


Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity. Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the \#1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

  



**What We Need:**


We’re looking for a Sales Coordinator to support our sales team in delivering exceptional client service. You’ll help manage the pre\- and post\-sale process, coordinate campaign execution across platforms, and ensure everything runs smoothly behind the scenes. The ideal candidate is detail\-oriented, collaborative, and thrives in a fast\-paced environment.  



**What You'll Do:**

* Responsible for understanding and supporting the sales process/procedures used by iHeartMedia Sales teams
* Enter and revise orders
* Submit special billing requests
* Work with Account Executives to generate proposals
* Respond to Account Executive requests regarding spot times
* Assist the sales team with sales material creation \& recaps

  



**What You'll Need:**

* Previous experience in a sales support or operational support role
* Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize and multitask in a fast\-paced environment
* Technical aptitude with knowledge of Salesforce, and Veritone a plus
* Experience with the Microsoft Office suite (Excel, Outlook, Word)
* A great attitude, flexibility, and creativity!
* An understanding of media sales or strong desire to learn about media sales
* Bi\-lingual in English and Spanish is a plus
  



**What You'll Bring:**

* Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return
* Full proficiency and understanding of job function
* Open communication with colleagues and direct reports that encourages collaboration and team consensus
* Strong problem solving skills
* Efficiency with independent work under minimal guidance
* Commitment to process improvement for overall team effectiveness
* Professional communication that stresses diplomacy, empathy and patience

 **Compensation:**

  

Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job\-related qualifications, and alignment with market data.

  

$17\.30 \- $21\.63

  



**Location:**


New York, NY: 125 West 55th Street, 10019  



**Position Type:**


Regular  



**Time Type:**


Full time  



**Pay Type:**


Hourly  



**Benefits:**


iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following:

* Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options
* Company provided and supplemental life insurance
* Paid vacation and sick time
* Paid company holidays
* A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community
* A 401K plan
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well\-being, family and caregiving
* A range of additional voluntary programs, such as spending accounts, student loan refinancing, accident insurance and more!

  



We are accepting applications for this role on an ongoing basis.


The Company is an equal opportunity employer and will not tolerate discrimination in employment on the basis of race, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, disability, ethnicity, national origin

jobs.description:
Overview : PRG is the world’s leading technology provider within the entertainment and events industry. Our mission is to bring together the power of our people with our production and rental expertise to deliver unforgettable events. PRG has the largest inventory of production equipment for hire and offers a complete 360\-degree range of services to clients within the live events industry. These include music touring and festivals, TV \& Film, Theatre, Sports and E\-sports and Corporate live events. Our clients and partners rely on PRG’s innovation, experience and in\-depth expertise in video, lighting, rigging, staging, virtual productions, and set \& automation systems to bring their creative visions to life. With 38 offices located in North America, South America, Europe, the Middle East, Asia and Australia, PRG offers the ability to provide services worldwide by collaborating with our local partners. Responsibilities:

The **Production Coordinator’s** primary responsibility is to support the Production Management group with the planning, budgeting, and execution of events and/or entertainment projects in all markets and facets PRG serves.

  

* They will support both on\-site and off\-site project efforts through the planning and delivery of the appropriate services, equipment and support.
* Assisting Production Management group with the creation of budget documents for new proposals,
* Gathering of quotes from third party vendors, and providing support to the PM/AM through the execution of a project. It is the policy of PRG to provide excellent customer service both internally and externally.
* Employees are expected to perform all of their duties and responsibilities in accordance with this policy at all times.
* Does related work as required.
* The Production Coordinator is responsible for supporting Production Managers with maintaining established event schedule, scope, and budget.

**Essential Functions:*** Open job numbers
* Create Purchase Orders
* Review submitted documents and requests for accuracy and compliance
* Asist in obtaining pre\-payments
* Help in troubleshooting issues with PO’s, invoices, payments for jobs for all projects
* Schedule or run job reports for Production Managers
* Assist Production Managers with project closeout
* Help in reconciliation of projects
* Responsible for processing of invoices, POs, and job number creation in conjunction with the accounting team.
* Track and update production labor submissions.
* Ensure receipt of signed contracts and official forms required for project execution i.e. proof of insurance, tax forms, and change order agreements.

  


Qualifications:
* High School Diploma or equivalency required.
* Microsoft Word and Excel proficiency is required.
* Completion of two years of post\-secondary education from an accredited institution of higher learning with a concentration in business administration, hospitality management, operations management or related entertainment technology fields. Or equivalent amount of production related experience.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in project coordination within the entertainment market or equivalent experience in shop or show site operations.
* Strong communication and customer service skills.
* Former PRG internship experience a plus
* Time management skills
* Ability to handle multiple projects at once.


EEO and Disclosure:
***The pay range for this position is estimated to be $75,000\.00\-100,000\.00\. Actual pay to be determined by the experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant combined with location and alignment with market data. Additionally, we offer comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) retirement savings plan with matching contributions.***

 *PRG is an Equal Opportunity Employer. PRG is a drug\-free work environment, pre\-employment testing will be required.*

 *This is a safety sensitive position and will require pre\-employment drug screening.*

 *Production Resource Group LLC participates in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I\-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.*

 *PRG cares about the safety of our employees and applicants. PRG does not use chat rooms for job searches or communications. PRG will never request personal information via informal chat platforms or unsecure email. PRG will never ask for money or an exchange of money, banking or other personal information prior to an in\-person interview. Be aware of potential scams while job seeking. For information on job scams, visit,* *https://www.consumer.ftc.gov/JobScams* *or file a complaint at* *https://www.ftccomplaintassistant.gov/**.*

**Who we are**
--------------


Puig is a home of Love Brands within a family company that furthers wellness, confidence and self\-expression while leaving a better world. For more than a century, our entrepreneurial spirit and passion for creativity have made us a challenger in the premium beauty industry.


With 17 Love Brands across Fragrance and Fashion, Makeup and Skincare, we create stories that connect with people’s emotions and are powered by a global team of over 13,000 passionate professionals. With products sold in more than 150 countries and €5,042 million in net revenue in 2025, and guided by strong values and sustainability commitments, Puig continues to grow as a Home of Creativity: an open\-minded space where Creators Of All Kinds are empowered to thrive, innovate and express who they are.


**The Opportunity**
-------------------


At Puig, we create desirable brands that spark emotion and shape culture. As a Media Coordinator, Prestige Marketing, you will play a pivotal role in supporting the execution and operational excellence of integrated media campaigns across our prestige fragrance portfolio, including Carolina Herrera, Rabanne, and Jean Paul Gaultier.


Reporting to the Senior Manager, Media \& Advocacy, you will partner closely with cross\-functional teams, agency partners, creators, retailers, and media networks to ensure campaigns are executed seamlessly from briefing through reporting. This is an exciting opportunity for an organized, curious, and digitally savvy marketing professional seeking to build a career at the intersection of luxury marketing, media, creator engagement, and consumer experience.


**What you'll get to do**
-------------------------


* Join a collaborative team of media and advocacy professionals, reporting to the Senior Manager, Media \& Advocacy
* Partner cross\-functionally with Brand Marketing, PR, Influencer, E\-Retail, DTC, and Creative teams to support integrated campaign planning and execution
* Assist in the development and coordination of national media, retail media, and creator marketing campaign briefs, ensuring strategic alignment across internal and external partners
* Manage and organize campaign creative assets, ensuring timely delivery and consistency across media channels and partner platforms. Coordinate asset updates and revisions with external agencies, vendors, and creative partners while maintaining alignment on brand standards and campaign objectives
* Support campaign reporting by transforming performance data and media metrics into polished presentations and actionable insights for local and international stakeholders
* Manage workflows and logistics related to influencer, advocate, agency, and vendor activations, ensuring flawless execution and delivery timelines
* Provide on\-site support for brand events, media activations, creator experiences, and VIP engagements
* Help streamline team operations through the development of efficient workflows, task management processes, meeting recaps, and follow\-up tracking to improve collaboration and accountability
* Support budget management activities, including purchase orders, invoice processing, financial reconciliation, and campaign budget tracking
* Monitor industry trends across media, luxury beauty, digital platforms, and creator partnerships to help inform future opportunities and best practices
**We'd love to meet you if you have**
-------------------------------------


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Digital Media, Communications, or a related discipline
* 1\-2 years of experience in media, marketing, advertising, communications, or related fields; relevant internship experience is welcomed
* Strong interest in media, creator marketing, luxury brands, emerging digital platforms, and consumer engagement
* Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong attention to detail, project management capabilities, and a proactive, solution\-oriented mindset
* Comfort working with campaign reporting, presentations, and performance data
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to build relationships across diverse stakeholder groups
* Fluency in Spanish or French is a plus
  

We welcome Creators Of All Kinds. If you are unsure of meeting all the requirements but trust you have the transferable skills to excel in this role, complete the application and our teams will get in touch if you are selected for an interview.


**Compensation**
----------------

As required by New York State’s salary transparency law, effective November 2022, the expected base salary for this position ranges from **$70,000\.00 \- $75,000\.00**. Various factors are considered when extending offers, such as relevant skillset, training, years of experience related to the current job description, education, and our organizational structure. In addition to the base salary, PUIG offers a competitive benefits package that includes health and dental insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, 401K, paid holidays, a generous paid time\-off policy, hybrid work environment, and career opportunities within a dynamic team.

* An entrepreneurial, creative and welcoming work culture
* A range of learning and development opportunities
* An international company with plenty of opportunities to grow
* A competitive compensation \& benefits package

jobs.description:
POSITION DESCRIPTION

**Full time:** 37\.5 to 40 hours weekly, with frequent evening and weekend hours

**Program:** Tax Program

**Reports to:** Program Director

**Salary:** $55,000\-$60,000 depending on experience

**Posted:** September 15, 2026

**Start Date:** October, 2026

**Full\- Time Outreach Coordinator\- VITA Program**

***In Person Service is an essential function of this position***

About Ariva

Ariva helps residents of New York City build financially empowered and prosperous lives. Our mission is to bring economic justice, opportunity and inclusion to our Bronx neighbors and other underserved New Yorkers. We offer free income tax preparation assistance and comprehensive financial capabilities services at locations across New York City. Information on our projects and programs can be found at www.ariva.org

Our goal is to understand the needs and experiences of the people we serve and to provide customized financial capabilities services to support their financial well being. Our staff, volunteers, and community partners offer honesty, reliability, care, and kindness in every interaction with our clients.

If our work and culture are a fit for you, we urge you to join our team!Tax Program

We are the most established free tax preparation community\-based organization in the Bronx, with 14 sites, including three\-year\-round locations. We help eligible New York City residents file their tax returns and claim credits such as the Earned Income Tax Credit and Child Tax Credit. Since 2003, we have prepared free tax returns for more than 152,000 clients, returning over $239 million in total refunds to underserved communities.

All of Ariva’s tax program staff and volunteers are IRS\-certified. All of our tax sites are sponsored by the IRS VITA program.

Position Description

We are seeking an Outreach Coordinator to work on the ground in Bronx neighborhoods where our tax sites are located to promote our program with Ariva’s target clients (lower income Bronx residents living and working in the communities where our sites are located). The outreach coordinator will also assist in scheduling appointments,

The ideal candidate will have strong organizational skills, outgoing. ability to work independently, and be equally enthusiastic about scheduling logistics and community engagement

Responsibilities

* Conduct outreach activities to promote Ariva services throughout the community.
* Build and maintain relationships with community organizations, schools, faith\-based groups, and other referral partners.
* Organize and conduct outreach presentations and information sessions.
* Maintain accurate records of outreach activities and referral sources.
* Monitor site capacity and appointment availability to maximize service delivery.
* Coordinate outreach campaigns through print, email, social media, and community events.
* Support tax site operations by ensuring clients receive timely information about required documents and appointment procedures.
* Track outreach metrics and prepare reports on appointment volume, referrals, and community engagement efforts.
* Attend community events, resource fairs, and partner meetings to increase awareness of free tax preparation services.
* Respond professionally to client concerns and help resolve scheduling conflicts.

**Experience** 

· Three years experience in outreach, preferably in a community\-based setting

· A college degree is not required, but a Bachelors degree may substitute for 1 year experience.

Core Competencies

· The Coordinator must pass the IRS Intake, Standards of Conduct, and Intake/Quality Review Certifications. (Ariva will provide training.)

* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Excellent customer service and communication abilities.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
* Comfortable with public speaking and community engagement.
* Flexible schedule, including availability for evenings and Saturdays through the year.

· Must be reliable, punctual, and detail oriented.

· Professional appearance and demeanor; adherence to Ariva’s dress code (business casual).

· Basic computer and phone skills

· Strong interpersonal skills and a passion for helping the community

· Bilingual English/Spanish required

· Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

Schedule

37\.5 to 40 hours weekly, with frequent evening and weekend hours, especially during the busy income tax filing season. Ths position is full in person in various neighborhoods throughout the Bronx

Ariva is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Pay: $55,000\.00 \- $60,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Experience:

* Outreach: 3 years (Preferred)

Language:

* Spanish (Required)

Work Location: In person

Social Media Manager, Organic \& Content


Location: Austin, TX or New York, NY / Hybrid  

Employment: Full\-time  

Reports to: CMO of Nood, Co\-Founder/CMO of Tempo


The Opportunity
Nood is a high\-growth beauty\-tech brand making at\-home hair removal more accessible, with an expanding roadmap of devices and skincare. We’re hiring a Social Media Manager to turn our products, customer experiences, and brand point of view into content people want to watch, share, and come back for.


You’ll own Nood’s organic social presence across Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok—from strategy and ideation through shooting, editing, publishing, and performance analysis. You’re a creator first: someone who understands why a video works and can bring an idea to life with a phone, a laptop, and good judgment.


You’ll also support brand incubations under the Nood umbrella, like Tempo, our recently launched wellness and supplement brand. Nood’s Co\-Founder/CMO and the relevant brand’s CEO will align on priorities and capacity.


What You’ll Own* Organic Social Strategy. Own content pillars, channel plans, and publishing calendars for Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok, tied to product priorities, audience needs, and targets for follower growth, views, engagement, and site traffic.
* Hands\-On Content Creation. Concept, shoot, edit, write, and publish short\-form videos, Reels, Stories, carousels, and other relevant formats. Produce the majority of day\-to\-day content yourself, bringing in teammates and other participants when they strengthen the story.
* Brand Voice \& Storytelling. Turn product education, real routines, customer questions, and cultural moments into distinctive content. Keep Nood recognizable while adapting execution to each platform.
* Creative Testing. Test hooks, formats, pacing, and recurring series. Spot relevant trends early, improve content using results, and carry winning ideas across brands.
* Audience Engagement. Manage comments, mentions, and DMs in each brand's voice; join relevant conversations and feature customers in recurring content. Route service issues to Customer Experience and turn recurring questions into content ideas.
* Content Collaboration. Partner with the Creator Partnerships \& Community Lead on content needs and publish approved creator assets. Work with Performance Creative and Paid Media to turn organic winners into ads, share audience insights, and bring paid learnings back into organic.
* Performance \& Reporting. Own social dashboards and report weekly on reach, retention, shares, saves, audience growth, and site traffic against targets. Explain what worked, what didn’t, and what you’ll change.
* Selective Portfolio Support. Help Tempo and future brands establish their social voice, test content, and support launches within agreed priorities. Document a repeatable playbook for a new brand’s first 90 days on social.


What This Role Is About
This is a hands\-on individual contributor role with ownership of both strategy and execution. Some days you’ll be filming a product demonstration. Others, you’ll be testing a new series or digging into why one video held attention and another didn’t.


Who You Are* You’re a creator and a doer who can take an idea from concept to published content.
* You have strong taste and know how to make content feel natural to each platform.
* You use audience feedback and data to sharpen your creative judgment.
* You’re organized, self\-directed, and comfortable producing consistently in a lean team.
* You collaborate well and communicate clearly when priorities compete.
* You balance creative speed with brand standards and approved product claims.


What Success Looks Like in Your First 90 Days* A clear social strategy and sustainable publishing cadence.
* A consistent flow of original content, with promising recurring formats.
* A reliable audience engagement and customer\-service handoff process.
* Simple reporting that connects performance to creative decisions.
* A focused plan for supporting Tempo alongside the brand's priorities.

  

**Requirements**  

* 3\+ years creating content and growing social accounts for consumer brands, or equivalent results building your own audience.
* A portfolio showing strong short\-form video skills and measurable results on Instagram and TikTok.
* Experience managing brand publishing across Meta platforms, including Facebook.
* Strong shooting, editing, copywriting, and basic production skills; comfortable with CapCut, Premiere, or similar tools.
* Ability to interpret content performance and translate it into practical decisions.
* Comfortable appearing on camera or directing others.
* Able to work in person regularly in Austin or New York for collaboration and content production.


Nice to have: beauty, skincare, or wellness experience; photography and design skills; paid social creative experience; or experience launching a new social account.

 **Benefits**  

Working draft for internal review: Proposed annual base salary of $90,000–$115,000, depending on experience and demonstrated capabilities. Final range, benefits, and any incentive compensation to be confirmed before posting.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
**About Outtake**
=================


Outtake exists to empower and facilitate trust for a digital\-first world. Today, impersonation, fraud, AI\-driven scams, and identity abuse spread faster than any security team can respond to. So we built something different: an agentic AI platform that proactively detects, monitors, and takes down impersonators, automating protection in hours, not weeks.

  

Built by ex\-Palantir, ex\-CTO/founders, and ex\-Notion engineers, Outtake is designed for clarity, autonomy, and velocity. Our goal is ambitious: become the trust layer of the modern internet. And we intend to do it with a lean, dense, exceptionally talented team.

  

Outtake is backed by top\-tier investors and operators who believe in our mission and our model. With strong financial footing and a long runway, we prioritize creating an environment where people can do the best work of their careers.

**The Role**
============


Outtake is looking for a Social Media Manager. You will own and grow Outtake's presence across LinkedIn and X, developing the strategy, building the editorial calendar, creating and publishing content, engaging with the audience, and tracking performance. You will have meaningful autonomy and will be expected to take a broad brief and turn it into a consistent stream of relevant, high\-quality content.


You will operate as a small, self\-directed content studio inside Outtake. Rather than waiting for assignments, you will proactively find stories across the company, spend time with employees and customers, and turn what you learn into timely, platform\-native content — working closely with the CEO to understand and sharpen Outtake's voice, then translate it consistently across the company's social channels.


This is a role that requires immersion in the conversation. You will immerse yourself in cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, online trust, identity, fraud, and the wider conversations shaping the internet, identifying where Outtake can contribute something timely and distinctive and finding compelling ways to bring the company into those conversations.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Own Outtake's company accounts across LinkedIn and X, from strategy and planning through publishing and performance analysis.
* Learn Outtake's product, customers, market, and point of view deeply enough to create content with limited oversight.
* Build your own content pipeline by proactively identifying interesting people, customer stories, product developments, and moments worth sharing.
* Interview employees and customers to uncover insights, stories, and perspectives that can become compelling social content.
* Turn interviews, conversations, and emerging ideas into posts, clips, graphics, and recurring content formats quickly.
* Identify emerging topics, news cycles, and online discussions where Outtake has a credible and interesting perspective.
* Create lightweight visual content, simple graphics, carousels, screenshots, and short\-form video edits to support social storytelling.
* Track audience growth, engagement, brand relevance, website traffic, and downstream business impact.
* As the content function matures, we expect this role to take on broader ownership over Outtake's editorial voice and content strategy.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* Demonstrated ability to create strong social content, whether through professional work, independent projects, or a compelling personal portfolio.
* The judgment to participate in timely conversations without sounding forced, opportunistic, or disconnected from the brand.
* Comfort owning a process independently, making decisions with incomplete information, and moving work forward without extensive oversight.
* The resourcefulness to take an idea from concept to finished post using the tools and support available.
* Experience creating lightweight visual assets and making quick video or image edits.
* Comfort using analytics to evaluate performance, identify patterns, and make informed creative decisions.
* Cybersecurity or AI experience is not required — we care more about your ability to learn quickly, develop informed perspectives, and turn complex ideas into content people want to engage with.

**Life at Outtake**
===================

* **Office:** For those in NY, we are an in\-person team (5 days a week, with flexibility as needed) working out of a stunning waterfront office in Brooklyn. Collaboration, speed, and clarity matter.
* **Health:** 100% company\-paid medical, dental, and vision for employees.
* **Time Away:** Flexible PTO. We trust adults to manage energy, not clock time.
* **Culture \& Team:** Annual company retreats and regular in\-person events.


Outtake is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team.


Compensation Range: $85K \- $95K

jobs.title: Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Sales Professional, Restaurant Manager, Culinary Manager or Chef looking for career development opportunities? Join Sysco’s World Class Sales Team and explore all the benefits and perks.


**Why you should join our Sales Team:**

* Competitive base salary, bonus, plus promotional incentive opportunities
* Car allowance (mileage reimbursement for candidates in CA) and cell phone provided
* Career pathing opportunities for both entry level, and experienced individuals
* Opportunity to be part of a purpose driven organization that supports communities and associates
* Specialized sales training
* Individual as well as team\-based selling
* Opportunity to learn different ethnic segments
* Monthly and annual sales rewards and recognition
* Robust benefits package including an Employee Stock Purchase Plan, \& 401(k) with automatic matching

**JOB SUMMARY**  

This is an outside sales position responsible for promoting the company's products and services and for building relationships with new and existing accounts. The main focus is to help Sysco customers succeed while achieving sales and profit goals established by the company. This position may require working some non\-traditional hours (evening, weekends, and holidays) to successfully meet customers' needs.  

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Develop new business, penetrate existing accounts, and minimize lost business to achieve profitable sales growth and special objectives within assigned territory.
* Seek and qualify prospects following company account stratification goals.
* Research customer business needs and develops a mix of products and service to meet needs.
* Evaluate market trends and recommend products to customers, based on business needs and goals.
* Be informed of market conditions, product innovations, and competitors' products, prices, and sales; share information with customers as part of value\-added services provided.
* Answer customers' questions about products, prices, availability, and product use.
* Provide product information and practical training to customer personnel.
* Drive personal vehicle to customer accounts, conventions, company meetings, etc.
* Communicate and collect accounts receivable as necessary, working with the credit department and client; collect all balances due based on approved credit terms.
* Manage deliveries to the routing schedule published by the transportation department; troubleshoot any problems that occur during the order process (for example, out of stock items, special order items, low inventory, etc.).
* Participate in company functions, promotions, customer visits, and customer events.
* Attend and participate in general sales and district meetings.
* Engage in ongoing training sessions.
* Assist with the training of new employees as requested.
* Review and analyze daily and weekly reports such as special\-order requests, customer bid files, and sales/gross profit margin data.
* Perform administrative duties, such as preparing sales budgets and reports, maintaining sales records, processing credits, and pick\-up requests, preparing sales quotes and menu suggestions, and filing reports.
* Other duties may be assigned.

 **QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required Education/Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, Hospitality, Culinary Arts or related discipline **OR** HSD/GED and 3 years Restaurant Management, B2B or outside sales experience, or equivalent relatable experience including completion of the Sysco Sales Internship.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bi\-Lingual
* Restaurant Management, Foodservice Outside Sales, Chef Experience preferred

**Certificates, Licenses, and Registrations**

* Valid driver’s license with a driving record that meets company insurability standards.
* Current automobile insurance with the following limits of liability: Bodily injury \- $100,000 each person and $300,000 each accident; property damage \- $100,000 is required

 **Requirement**

* Pass employment testing
* Must sign Sysco Protective Covenants Agreement.
* Reside or willing to relocate to the geographical vicinity of territory.

 **Professional Skills**

* Basic PC skills and proficiency with MS Office.
* Ability to read, write, speak English.

 **Competencies**

* Building Trust
* Building Customer Loyalty
* Follow\-up
* Sales Ability / Persuasiveness
* Managing Work
* Adaptability
* Communication

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About the Role**
Club Athletic is a community\-first fitness brand built on the Training Squad: people who train together, twice a week, at a set time, with a dedicated coach. Every month a large number of people create an account with us but never take the next step — they don't book a call, attend a class, or join a squad. This role exists to change that. As our Sales Development Representative, you own that overlooked pool of leads. Through the week you reach out to people who signed up but went quiet and get them booked onto a call. On weekends you run those calls yourself and close them into memberships. It's a role for someone who loves both the chase and the close — persistent on outreach, warm on the phone, motivated by clear targets and real commission.


**What Success Looks Like**
Targets are set and reviewed with the Sales Manager. Not all are tied to commission, but all measure success in the role.


Primary Metrics

* Calls Booked — Number of placement / sales calls booked from the unactioned\-lead pool each month.
* Show Rate — Lifting the share of booked calls that actually attend (the current show rate has room to grow).
* Memberships Closed — New Training Squad memberships you personally close each month.
* Speed\-to\-Lead (SLA) — Meet the response SLA — every lead contacted within 90 minutes during operating hours, and first thing at 8am for leads that come in after 7pm.
* Memberships Closed — New Training Squad memberships you personally close each month. • Speed\-to\-Lead (SLA) — Meet the response SLA — every lead contacted within 90 minutes during operating hours, and first thing at 8am for leads that come in after 7pm.

Secondary Metrics

* Call\-to\-Member Conversion — Share of attended calls that convert to a membership.
* Pipeline Hygiene — Accurate, up\-to\-date lead tracking so no lead falls through the cracks.
* Member Experience — Professional, on\-brand, helpful experience on every call.

**What You'll Do****Work the unactioned lead pool (week days)**

* Contact every new account that hasn't booked or bought, while intent is still warm.
* Response SLA — Meet the lead\-response SLA: every lead contacted within 90 minutes during operating hours. Leads that arrive after 7pm are contacted first thing at 8am the next morning.
* Run multi\-channel outreach — call, text, and email — to get leads onto a placement or sales call.
* Confirm and remind every booked call so people actually show up; reducing no\-shows is a core part of the job.
* Keep the lead tracker accurate and current so every lead has a clear next step.

**Run and close sales calls (weekends)**

* Take sales calls for 2 hours on Saturdays \& Sundays
* Convert interested prospects into Training Squad memberships, matching them to the right squad and time.
* Hand off new members cleanly to the studio General Manager and coaching team for onboarding.

**Own your pipeline and report**

* Take full ownership of your pipeline from first outreach to closed membership.
* Report weekly on calls booked, calls attended, and memberships closed, and flag what's working and what isn't.

  

**Requirements**  

* Available to work mornings as early as 7am, evenings as late as 8pm, and weekends
* 1\-2 years of sales experience in high volume sales, fitness background a plus

**Who You Are**

* Self\-Starter \& Resilient — Comfortable with high\-volume outreach and the occasional no; doesn't need to be chased.
* A Natural Closer — Warm, genuine, and persuasive on the phone; people trust you quickly.
* Organized — Tracks every lead and follow\-up without dropping the ball.
* Commercially Minded — Understands that booked, attended, and closed are different things, and works to move all three.
* Coachable \& Community\-First — Open to feedback and coaching, and genuinely cares about the member and the community

  

**Benefits**  

* Part\-time Hourly Position averaging **10\-24 hours per week**, hours to be confirmed based on your availability and company needs
* **Base Rate:** $28\-40 / hour dependent on experience
* **Commission:**
* + $30 for every call that is booked AND attended (paid on attended calls as recorded in Mindbody, not on bookings).
	+ $75 for every new Training Squad membership personally closed.

jobs.title: PI and Referral Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**PI and Referral Operations Coordinator**

We are an outpatient diagnostic imaging center serving patients, attorneys, medical practices, referral networks, and Workers' Compensation partners throughout Metro Atlanta.

We are seeking an organized and proactive PI and Referral Operations Coordinator to manage the operational workflow for personal\-injury, attorney, One Call, Workers' Compensation, insurance, and other external referrals.

This position is responsible for referral tracking, attorney and referral\-partner communication, LOP documentation coordination, authorization follow\-up, appointment coordination, and preparing completed cases for handoff to the billing department.

This is not a medical billing position. The role works closely with our biller, but billing, claims, denials, payments, and collections remain with the billing department.

Spanish\-speaking ability is strongly preferred but not required.

**What you will do**

\- Receive and track personal\-injury, attorney, One Call, Workers' Compensation, insurance, and other external referrals  
\- Maintain an accurate referral tracker with case status, missing information, next action, owner, and follow\-up date  
\- Communicate professionally with attorneys, law offices, clinics, referral coordinators, case managers, and network partners  
\- Confirm that referrals include the required patient, study, order, diagnosis, authorization, and contact information  
\- Track Letters of Protection and related documentation  
\- Request missing LOP documents and route completed packets for management review  
\- Track whether an LOP has been approved, is pending, needs revision, or has been declined  
\- Coordinate with the Patient Access and Imaging Coordinator to schedule patients once the referral is ready  
\- Track prior authorization status when authorization is required  
\- Follow up with referring offices, attorneys, payers, and referral partners regarding missing or delayed information  
\- Track Workers' Compensation information such as claim details, employer information, adjuster information, and authorization status  
\- Coordinate One Call and other referral\-network workflows  
\- Monitor open referrals and identify cases that have stalled  
\- Provide appointment and referral\-status updates to authorized referral sources  
\- Confirm when studies have been completed  
\- Assemble complete front\-end information for the billing department  
\- Route completed cases to the biller with the appropriate order, diagnosis, authorization, LOP, referral, and payer information  
\- Track cases that are waiting for billing handoff or additional documentation  
\- Maintain organized email records, referral notes, and case documentation  
\- Prepare referral\-status and aging reports for management  
\- Escalate legal, financial, clinical, or payer exceptions to the appropriate person  
\- Protect patient privacy and follow HIPAA and Georgia Health Imaging procedures

**What this role does not own**

This position coordinates the referral and documentation workflow but does not independently:

\- Approve or negotiate Letters of Protection  
\- Change legal or financial terms  
\- Provide legal advice  
\- Negotiate referral contracts or reimbursement rates  
\- Submit or correct claims  
\- Perform medical coding  
\- Manage denials  
\- Post payments or ERAs  
\- Handle collections  
\- Approve discounts or write\-offs  
\- Make clinical decisions  
\- Determine MRI protocols or contrast requirements  
\- Provide clinical interpretations  
\- Administer PACS, VPN, DICOM, or network systems

The coordinator is responsible for making sure the case is organized, documented, tracked, and routed to the appropriate decision\-maker.

**Required qualifications**

\- Previous experience in healthcare referral coordination, medical office administration, personal\-injury healthcare, Workers' Compensation, case management, medical records, or a related field  
\- Strong written and verbal communication skills  
\- Excellent organization and attention to detail  
\- Ability to manage multiple active cases with different deadlines  
\- Strong follow\-up skills and the ability to close the loop on open tasks  
\- Professional communication with attorneys, medical offices, patients, and referral partners  
\- Comfort working with email, spreadsheets, referral trackers, and web\-based systems  
\- Ability to maintain confidential patient and legal\-related information  
\- Ability to identify missing information and escalate issues appropriately  
\- Reliable attendance and consistent follow\-through

**Preferred qualifications**

\- Experience coordinating personal\-injury referrals  
\- Experience with Letters of Protection or lien\-based medical workflows  
\- Experience working with attorneys or law offices  
\- Experience with One Call, Workers' Compensation, Scan.com, AIC, or other medical referral networks  
\- Experience tracking prior authorizations  
\- Experience in radiology, orthopedics, pain management, chiropractic, or outpatient imaging  
\- PracticeSuite, EHR, EMR, or medical practice\-management experience  
\- Experience with referral portals or patient scheduling platforms  
\- Familiarity with MRI, CT, ultrasound, or diagnostic imaging workflows  
\- Spanish\-speaking ability  
\- Medical administrative, case\-management, or healthcare coordination training

**The ideal candidate**

The right person is highly organized, persistent, professional, and comfortable working with multiple outside parties. You can maintain a detailed case tracker, identify what is missing, communicate clearly about next steps, and follow a referral until it is scheduled, completed, and properly handed off.

You understand the difference between coordinating a legal or financial document and approving it. You are comfortable escalating exceptions rather than making unauthorized promises to patients, attorneys, or referral partners.

jobs.description:
Discover Your Career at Emory University: Emory University is a leading research university that fosters excellence and attracts world\-class talent to innovate today and prepare leaders for the future. We welcome candidates who can contribute to the excellence of our academic community. Description:

The Case Manager and Communications Coordinator reports to the Associate Director, Student Case Management and Intervention Services and is part of a team that provides immediate support, follow\-up, and care coordination to all Emory University students. This position is integral to student flourishing and creating a sense of belonging here at Emory as professionals within this office are tasked with identifying, assessing, and coordinating care between internal and external University partners to assist students with their overall personal and academic success.  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:  

The Case Manager and Communications Coordinator is responsible for the following:* Provides individual assessment, support, and advocacy for all Emory undergraduate, graduate, and professional students.
* Identifies and coordinates care amongst appropriate on\-campus and community resources within a social justice frame work for student needs including but not limited to: housing and food insecurity, financial hardship, mental and medical health concerns, and accessibility needs.
* Assists in the coordination of support mechanisms between individual colleges and offices to university case management.
* Participates in a variety of interdepartmental team meetings as needed to support effective communication, tracking, and follow up with student progress.
* Assists in supporting the relationships developed between campus partners. Examples include, but are not limited to: Student Health Services, Psychiatry, Counseling and Psychological Services, and Student Case Management and Intervention Services and with other partners and constituents in the College and graduate and professional schools.
* Collaborates with and helps market Eagle Food Co\-Op pantry resources.
* Accurately documents all individual student contacts in a timely manner.
* Assists Director in collecting, analyzing, and reporting data for the department for the monthly, annual campus and community assessment process.
* Performs other duties as assigned and necessary.

  

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:* A master's degree in student affairs, social work, psychology, counseling, or related field from an accredited institution, and two years of related work experience.
* May be required to return to campus to support students.
* Services will include consultation with clinical providers, crisis case management, pre\-admission screening for placement, supporting basic needs and report writing.
* Ability to communicate, problem solve, and work effectively within a diverse college environment.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Ability to take initiative and create a vision for completion of required tasks to assist students and campus partners.
* Skilled at creating and establishing strong rapport with students, team, and internal and external University partners.
