jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Why DelRicht Research?**



Would you love to be a part of the cutting edge of healthcare and science innovation? Do you want to be an influential part of a rapidly growing team? Are you looking for a position that has sustainable opportunity for professional growth? If the answer is yes, then DelRicht Research might be the right opportunity for you!

  

**Who We Are**



DelRicht is a clinical research company dedicated to providing an excellent customer experience to all patients that participate in our clinical trials. Our clinical trials provide new treatment options for our patients and ultimately our goal is to get new medications and medical devices FDA approved! We hold our team members to a high standard of excellence and are looking for energetic, positive, quick learners to be a part of our team. Presently our network stretches across 33 sites throughout the United States in 18 states.


**DelRicht Research has been recognized as a Top Workplace for 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026!** This is a testament to our unwavering commitment to creating an exceptional work environment that fosters growth, collaboration, and employee satisfaction.

  

#### **Clinical Research Coordinator's Main Objective**



Overall, the **Clinical Research Coordinator** is responsible for delivering an excellent patient experience while driving accurate, efficient study execution across our clinics, ensuring:


* Patients have a positive, professional, and comfortable experience throughout their time in our clinic
* Patient visits are completed accurately and efficiently, with close adherence to clinical trial protocols
* Patient recruitment, enrollment, and retention activities are executed with strong focus and follow\-through
* Patients are guided through the clinical trials process, ensuring they attend and complete required visits
* Clinical and visit data are entered timely and accurately into required systems and documentation platforms
* Ensuring Sponsors and Clients have amazing customer service when they are onsite at our clinic and assuring we are always providing clear, constant communication with them when they are off site
* Serve as a reliable point of coordination for internal teams, physicians, sponsors, and research partners involved in active studies
* Help maintain strong physician confidence by staying organized, communicating clearly, and keeping stakeholders informed on patient and protocol updates
* Work proactively in a fast\-paced, high\-expectation environment, solving problems and helping keep daily operations on track


**Skills needed to win:**


* ***Required****:* 1\+ years of professional experience in a fast\-paced, high\-expectation healthcare environment.
* ***Preferred:*** Bachelor's or Associate's degree from an accredited college or university.
* ***Preferred:*** Active RMA, CCMA, CMA, LPN, or RN certificate
* Strong preference for candidates with experience working toward KPIs, metrics, or performance expectations
* This is an onsite Monday\-Friday position
* Coffee drinkers preferred. Tea drinkers accepted.


**The Right Candidate Will:**


* Be self motivated! Energetic! Positive!
* Focus on providing exceptional patient care and creating memorable experiences
* Make sure client satisfaction is a primary focus and that the client is able to achieve and exceed their goals
* Believe in high quality and have a high standard of compliance to our study protocols
* Be remarkably organized
* Be skilled at problem solving, planning and being proactive
* Accept ownership of tasks from inception through completion and assume responsibility for personal success

  

  

**DelRicht Research's Core Values: Production, Humility, Consistency**


**Production:**


* We deliver on our promises
* We have a bias towards action: we value independent problem solving
* We proactively over deliver: we can act without being told what to do and we always have new ideas that will be heard and will improve the company


**Humility:**


* We support each other relentlessly
* We always have enthusiasm: we exhibit passion and excitement about our work which leads to everyone having a 'can do' attitude
* We embrace change: we are excited to always be growing and moving the organization forward which means change is the norm for us
* Coachable: we all love to learn, we are willing to be taught and will adapt quickly
  


**Consistency:**


* We always are able to execute: we get it right the first time and promote 'touch it once' accuracy
* We have persistence: we demonstrate the tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done
* We are calm under pressure: we can maintain stable performance when under heavy pressure or stress


**Team Perks \& Benefits at DelRicht Research:**


* Medical Insurance, with generous employer paid contributions
* Dental and Vision Insurance
* Short and Long Term Disability and Group Life Coverage
* Paid Time Off that builds throughout your career with the company
* 401K (\+ discretionary match/profit sharing)
* Quarterly Bonus Plan that clearly outlines your bonus potential per quarter and giving the team the visibility and control to maximize earnings by hitting team goals
* Professional Development Program tailored to each team member's profess goals. Our quarterly goal\-setting initiative is designed to challenge our team members to reach and exceed their potential!
* Success\-Driven Environment where data drives our decisions and insights. Be a part of a winning team that prioritizes transparency, continuous improvement, and success!
  


**Job Type**: Full\-Time 40\+ hrs  

**Salary**: $55,000\-$60,000

  

Visit our website linked below to learn about our company and current clinical trials, see patient testimonials, and check out our careers page!  

Website: www.delrichtresearch.com  

Patient Testimonials: https://delrichtresearch.com/testimonials/

  

*We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants equally wit

jobs.description:
**BMW of Gwinnett Place, a Penske Automotive Group dealership, is looking for a Sales Coordinator to join our team and deliver extraordinary customer experiences.**


**JOIN OUR TEAM**



At Penske Automotive Group (PAG), we strive to create a positive and challenging workplace that promotes excellence and achievement, and we aim to deliver the very best experience possible to our customers. We are looking for dedicated and motivated professionals who share that same passion to join our team.



Imagine working in a professionally and financially satisfying job where you have the opportunity to make a positive impact on our organization and customers every day. The Sales Assistant assists the dealership Sales team in finding specific vehicles, responding to customers, supporting the sales process, and following\-up with customers after vehicle purchase. The Sales Assistant is required to demonstrate a sound understanding of the latest industry trends, features and benefits of each vehicle. To be a successful Sales Assistant, you should have strong customer service, communication, and problem solving skills.


**WHAT WE HAVE TO OFFER**


* Fortune 500 company, consistently recognized by Automotive News as among the "Best Dealerships to Work For."
* Proudly named to Glassdoor's Best Places to Work
* Competitive compensation with uncapped earning potential \- our commission\-based pay structure allows you to control your income.
* Comprehensive benefits program, including health care options (medical, dental and vision) and 401k savings and retirement plan with company match.
* Training, resources and opportunities for career growth and advancement, tailored to individual performance, experience and interests.
* Values\-driven culture built on integrity, professionalism, excellence and teamwork.


**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**


* Genuine interest in providing an exceptional customer experience.
* Friendliness, enthusiasm, reliability, with a positive "team\-player" attitude.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal and organizational skills.
* Strong work\-ethic with the ability to work in a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment.


**WHAT YOU CAN BRING TO THE TABLE**


* Commitment: Ensure our customers have a world\-class car\-buying experience at every step along their sales journey.
* Excellence: Provide an unparalleled level of knowledge, expertise, and authenticity to help customers find the vehicle they're looking for.
* Growth Mindset: Strive to grow the dealership and your career by hitting challenging monthly goals.
* Initiative: Bring new business to the dealership through referrals, networking and repeat business.
* Authenticity: Connect with customers about their vehicle questions in a professional manner that reflects understanding, clarity and accuracy, and courtesy.
* Growth Mindset: Strive to grow the sales department and your career by hitting challenging monthly goals.


**APPLY WITH US!**



If you are ready for a rewarding career with competitive compensation and benefits, and opportunities to excel and advance, consider joining us on the Penske Automotive Group team. Our interview process typically includes a phone interview, several in\-person interviews, background check, reference check, driving record review and a drug screen. Be a part of the best customer experience team in the automotive industry... apply with us today!



Penske Automotive Group is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a drug\- and alcohol\-free workplace. Some positions may require applicants to possess a valid driver's license and have a good driving record.

jobs.title: Administration & Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Position: Admin \& Operations Coordinator  


Organization: Administration \& Human Resources  


Classification: Non\-Exempt / Exempt  


Reports to: Operations Manager / Sr. Manager – Administration  


Summary: Vatic Outsourcing, a growing telecom consulting firm, is seeking a highly organized, dependable, and detail\-oriented Admin \& Operations Specialist to manage daily office operations, facilities management, and administrative workflows. This on\-site role is essential to maintaining seamless daily business activities, including local errands, vendor management, office upkeep, and basic financial support.  


Major Duties and Responsibilities:  


Facilities \& Building Management  


Oversee the daily upkeep, maintenance, and cleanliness of all office buildings.  
Coordinate and schedule routine inspections, maintenance, and emergency repairs for HVAC, plumbing, electrical systems, and office equipment.  
Act as the primary point of contact for property managers, cleaning crews, and third\-party facility vendors.  
Manage vendor contracts, negotiate service agreements, and review/approve facility\-related invoices.  
Plan and manage office layout changes, seating arrangements, ergonomic setups, and workstation prep for new team members.  
Maintain office inventory, track physical assets, order supplies, and manage repair logistics for office equipment.  


Daily Administrative \& Daily Operations  


Daily Local Errands: Travel locally daily to the company PO box to collect physical mail and checks, and perform daily bank deposits at the local bank branch.  
Sort and distribute incoming physical mail and process all outgoing mail and package shipments.  
Handle core administrative tasks, including document management, electronic filing, data entry, and recordkeeping.  
Assist in planning and coordinating company events, celebrations, and philanthropic initiatives.  
Assist with internal operational communications, announcements, and office updates.  
Support HR functions such as recruitment coordination, onboarding, and employee engagement activities.  
Handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion.  
Serves as the receptionist for the office, greeting visitors and candidates for interviews.  
Prepare HR reports and documentation as needed.  


Financial \& Basic Operational Support  


Process and deposit incoming physical checks at the local bank daily.  
Enter client payments into internal accounting tracking systems and QuickBooks.  
Assist with basic client invoicing, accounts payable tracking, and processing routine operational expenses.  
Handle confidential business and financial information with high discretion.  


Required Skills \& Abilities:  


Must have a valid driver’s license, a reliable vehicle, and clean driving record for daily mandatory local trips (PO box and bank).  
Strong organizational, multitasking, and problem\-solving skills with high attention to detail.  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.  
Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Google Suite, and basic accounting software (QuickBooks preferred).  
Hands\-on experience working with facilities vendors, maintenance technicians, and service contracts.  
Ability to work independently and manage daily routine responsibilities without constant supervision.  


Physical Requirements:  


Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.  
Must be able to lift up to 25–30 pounds for handling packages, office supplies, and setup needs.  
Daily local driving required.  


Education \& Experience:  


Two to three years of administrative, office operations, or facilities management experience preferred.  
Experience handling basic bookkeeping/QuickBooks or banking procedures preferred.  
High school diploma required; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred.  


Work Environment:  


This position is a 100% on\-site role operating in a professional office environment. Must be available in\-person daily to perform facilities checks and complete daily bank/PO box runs.  


Supervisory Responsibility: While there is not a formal responsibility for personnel management, this role will work closely with various members of internal peer and management organizations.  


Additional Eligibility Qualifications  


Work Authorization/Security Clearance (if applicable)  
Job contingent upon a background check  


EEO Statement: It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunity to all individuals. We are committed to a diverse workforce. We value all employees’ talents and support an environment that is inclusive and respectful. We are strongly committed to this policy and believe in the concept and spirit of the law.  


Vatic’ s policy is to provide equal employment opportunity to qualified persons without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, known mental and physical disabilities, or veteran status. Federal and state laws require this, and we believe equal employment opportunity is simply good business practice.  


Other Duties: Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

jobs.title: Territory Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Build the Future with Us —** **EquipmentShare is Hiring a Territory Account Manager (Tooling Solutions)**
===========================================================================================================



At EquipmentShare, we're not just filling a role — **we're assembling the best team on the planet to build something that's never been built before**. We're on a mission to transform an industry that's been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real\-time support, and a team that truly cares.



We're hiring a **Territory Account Manager** at our *Tooling* *Solutions* rental facility in **Atlanta, GA**, and we're looking for someone who's ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction. Territory Account Managers will be responsible for expanding our existing customer base by building relationships with contractors and construction company principals. Tooling Solutions branches offer industrial tooling rentals including power tools, pneumatic tools, hand tools, and more.


**Pay:** $150,000 \- $600,000 Total Compensation ($52,000 base salary \+ Uncapped commission with no market restrictions)



### **Primary Responsibilities**


* Produce revenue inside facilities by signing contracts or acquiring an MSA
* Generate revenue by renting direct to non\-contract facilities
* Work with local industrial reps in multiple markets
* Gather all information on requirements to facilitate RFQs
* Quickly respond to inbound leads and requests
* Expand our existing customer base by building relationships with contractors and construction company principals. Tell them about the numerous ways EquipmentShare can help save them money, make more money and operate more efficiently. In other words, educate them on how EquipmentShare solves their problems!
* Maintain and nurture existing customer relationships to ensure our customers are 100 percent satisfied with the level of service and support they receive from EquipmentShare. Keep them up\-to\-date about new or additional ways in which EquipmentShare can help improve their business.
* Promptly respond to and resolve customer inquiries, requests, complaints or other communications.
* Develop new sales strategies and techniques to increase our market share and improve our customer experience.
* Frequent travel: Must be able to physically visit locations within assigned territory.
* Manages and supports job site activities and projects with remote and on site involvement.
* Assists with Equipment rental, sales, and service when needed by customers on\-site.

### **Why EquipmentShare?**



Because we do things differently — and we think you'll feel it from day one. We're a people\-first company powered by cutting\-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn't just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you're behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports *you*, and you drive *us* forward.



We're a team of problem\-solvers, go\-getters, and builders. And we're looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of **building something special**.


**Perks \& Benefits**


* Competitive compensation: Base salary plus uncapped commission
* Commission guarantee period while building book of business
* Company provided truck or Vehicle allowance ($800/mo)
* Company provided cell phone or phone stipend
* Relocation assistance (discretionary)
* Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for full\-time employees
* 401(k) and company match
* Generous PTO \+ paid holidays
* Gym membership stipend \+ wellness programs (earn PTO and prizes!)
* Company events, food truck nights, and monthly team dinners
* 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year — give back to the community you call home
* Career advancement, leadership training, and professional development opportunities

### **About You**



You want to be part of a team that's not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we're transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you're excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast\-paced, mission\-driven environment.



We're looking for people who:


See challenges as opportunities  

* 

Embrace change and continuous improvement  
* 
* Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day
### **Skills \& Qualifications**


* First and foremost, we're looking for someone who's tenacious and innovative and possesses superior sales skills
* 5 years experience in Industrial facilities
* Industrial contract knowledge
* Must be able to lift, carry, and place objects weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance.
* Knowledge in general rental, pump and power and industrial tooling

**Overview**

Sunpath Solar is seeking an organized, personable, and sales\-oriented Inside Sales \& Community Engagement Manager to help manage the front end of our sales process and ensure prospective customers receive a responsive, professional, and educational experience. This is a blended role combining inside sales, sales administration, customer engagement, and community outreach. The majority of the position is focused on managing inbound leads, qualifying prospective customers, maintaining our CRM and sales pipeline, coordinating appointments and handoffs, following up with opportunities, and supporting the broader sales team. The role also serves as an important public\-facing representative of Sunpath, helping build relationships with community organizations, nonprofits, houses of worship, schools, local governments, and other partners.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working with people but is also highly organized and process\-oriented — someone who can have a great conversation with a prospective customer and then make sure every note, task, document, and next step is accurately captured and followed through. The role is approximately 70% inside sales and sales administration, with the remaining time focused on customer education, sales support, and community engagement.

**Description**

**Inside Sales \& Lead Management**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for inbound leads from phone, email, website inquiries, referrals, marketing campaigns, and community events.
* Qualify prospective customers by gathering project goals, property and utility information, timelines, decision\-making criteria, and required supporting documents.
* Schedule consultations and proposal reviews, maintain consistent follow\-up with active and older leads, and re\-engage opportunities that have stalled.
* Provide introductory education about solar, battery storage, financing, incentives, project timelines, and Sunpath's sales and installation process.

**Sales Administration \& CRM**

* Maintain complete and accurate CRM records, including lead status, customer communications, qualification notes, appointments, and follow\-up tasks.
* Manage the flow of opportunities through the sales pipeline and coordinate effective handoffs to outside sales representatives and other team members.
* Develop and maintain CRM best practices, dashboards, KPIs, reporting, and sales SOPs from initial inquiry through project turnover.
* Support proposal follow\-up, appointment confirmation, customer communications, and other activities needed to move qualified opportunities toward contract.
* Identify and implement improvements to lead intake, follow\-up, CRM management, and sales processes.

**Community Engagement \& Outreach**

* Develop and maintain relationships with neighborhood organizations, nonprofits, schools, houses of worship, municipal partners, and other community organizations.
* Develop, coordinate, and represent Sunpath at community events, workshops, tabling opportunities, speaking engagements, and other outreach activities.
* Coordinate event materials and outreach efforts with Marketing, and ensure resulting leads are captured, qualified, and followed up through the sales process.
* Track community engagement activities and outcomes to evaluate the effectiveness of events and partnerships.

**Additional Sales Responsibilities**

* Participate in ongoing training on solar technology, products, financing, policy, and Sunpath's consultation process.
* As assigned, present, manage, and close specific sales opportunities in addition to the role's primary inside\-sales responsibilities.
* Provide general support for the Atlanta office, including coordination of facilities, vendors, deliveries, and workspace needs as assigned.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is a strong communicator who is also exceptionally organized. They should enjoy talking with customers, asking questions, following up, and helping people navigate a decision, while also being comfortable managing CRM systems, tracking details, maintaining processes, and holding themselves accountable for follow\-through.

We would especially value candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas:

* Inside sales
* Sales coordination or sales administration
* Customer service or customer success

Solar industry experience is helpful but not required. The ability to learn technical information, communicate clearly, stay organized, and consistently follow through is more important.

Sunpath is committed to providing a workplace free from discrimination or harassment. We believe that the unique contributions of all members of Sunpath’s team create our success. Overview:

This position sits within our Marketing division, which plans, directs, implements, and measures marketing programs for our company, people, and software products.

**The Opportunity**


We’re looking for a creative, video\-first Social Media Manager who wants more than a job managing a content calendar. We want someone who sees a boring social post and immediately thinks, “There’s a much better way to do this.” You’ll own the day\-to\-day organic social presence across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, and Reddit, with opportunities to explore new channels like TikTok. More importantly, you’ll have a lot of freedom to shape what our social presence becomes. Have an idea for a new series, campaign, video, game, quiz, podcast, or something we haven’t thought of yet? Bring it to the table. We’re big believers in experimenting, learning quickly, and trying again — whether that means failing fast or finding something that works and doing more of it. You’ll have access to the people, customers, products, and stories across our organization to create content that people want to watch, engage with, and share.

  

And there’s no shortage of stories to tell. Construction is one of the largest industries in the world, and ConstructConnect is the technology helping bring some of the coolest buildings and projects to life — from sports stadiums and hospitals to high\-rise buildings and major commercial developments. We’re at the start of every major project, and there’s a huge opportunity to make the industry feel as interesting online as it is in the real world. jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**  
We are seeking a **Business Development Representative – Stone \& Cabinet** to drive new business growth by developing customer relationships, reactivating dormant accounts, and expanding market presence in the field. This role is ideal for a sales professional who is strong in prospecting, customer visits, relationship building, and converting small or occasional purchases into stable monthly business. Experience in stone, cabinets, kitchen \& bath, or related building materials is preferred.

**About Us**

BCS Stone \& Cabinets Inc. serves local and regional customers with integrated stone and cabinetry solutions for residential and commercial projects. Backed by the broader Best Cheer platform, our business benefits from vertically integrated sourcing, manufacturing, and supply capabilities built since 1994\.

We support fabricators, builders, contractors, remodelers, dealers, distributors, and other trade customers with slabs, prefabricated countertops, vanity tops, tiles, mosaics, façade panels, cut\-to\-size products, and cabinetry solutions. With factory\-direct advantages, strong inventory support, competitive pricing, and responsive service, we help our customers source efficiently, stay competitive, and keep projects moving.

**Why Choose BCS?**

l **Fast Fulfillment**: Many orders placed before 12 PM can ship the same day, helping our sales team respond quickly and win business.

l **Sales Advantage:** Factory\-direct pricing, strong inventory support, and broad product selection help our field sales team compete effectively and close business faster.

l **Global Powerhouse:** Work for a leader with 30 years of history and the country’s largest inventory of prefabricated stone and cabinetry.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prospect and develop new business opportunities with fabricators, contractors, builders, remodelers, and other target customers in the local and surrounding markets.
* Reactivate dormant accounts and turn inactive customers into recurring purchasing accounts.
* Conduct regular field visits, customer meetings, and jobsite visits to expand market coverage and strengthen customer relationships.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with new and existing customers by understanding their project needs, buying cycles, and product requirements.
* Promote BCS stone and cabinet products by presenting product advantages, pricing value, delivery speed, and inventory support.
* Convert small or occasional purchases into stable repeat business by increasing order frequency, customer retention, and share of wallet.
* Follow up consistently on customer inquiries, samples, quotes, and open opportunities to move prospects through the sales pipeline and close business.
* Identify new sales opportunities through cold outreach, referrals, market visits, trade relationships, and account development efforts.
* Coordinate with design support, operations, and management to ensure accurate quoting, design follow\-through when needed, smooth order execution, and strong customer satisfaction.
* Develop and manage a portfolio of self\-generated accounts, building long\-term customer relationships and driving repeat business growth.
* Maintain organized records of customer visits, pipeline status, account activity, and sales progress, and provide regular updates on market feedback and business opportunities.

**Qualifications**

* 2\+ years of experience in outside sales, business development, field sales, or account acquisition.
* Proven ability to prospect, develop new customers, and grow sales through relationship\-based selling.
* Strong communication, follow\-up, negotiation, and closing skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage a sales territory, and maintain a consistent customer visit schedule.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust with customers and business partners.
* Experience in stone, cabinets, kitchen \& bath, building materials, or related industries is preferred.
* Existing relationships with fabricators, contractors, builders, remodelers, or related trade customers are a plus.
* Ability to read basic blueprints, measurements, or project layouts is preferred.
* Valid Georgia driver’s license, good driving record, and ability to be added to the company’s vehicle insurance, if required.
* Bilingual in Spanish, Russian or Chinese is preferred.
* Experience with 2020 Design or similar cabinet design software is a plus.
* Ability to occasionally work weekends, attend customer events, or travel within the assigned market, if needed.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* Base salary of $46,000 plus uncapped commission. Typical first\-year earnings are expected to reach $55,000–$100,000\+.
* **Zero\-Threshold Commission:** Earn commission on your very first sale from Day 1—no minimum quota required.
* **Car \& Travel Allowance:** Business mileage reimbursement or company car with fuel expense coverage.
* **Retirement:** 401(k) with 3% Company Match
* **Insurance:** Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans.
* **Time Off:** 10 days of PTO in the first year plus Paid Holidays.

**Working Conditions**  
Multiple environments including office and warehouse.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Best Cheer Stone is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.

Pay: $55,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

**About EPD:**

Caterpillar's Electric Power Division (EPD) offers integrated solutions, parts, and services to meet the needs of our various commercial and industrial electric power customers. EPD supports a wide range of customer applications across the globe, including providing back\-up power to hospitals, providing emergency power when natural disasters strike, and supporting critical infrastructure for data centers, municipalities, and more. With a rich history of more than 95 years in the electric power business, our team has world\-class expertise and a proven ability to adapt to changing demands. We’re committed to providing sustainable and reliable solutions to our customers. Join our team to help build a better, more sustainable world for future generations!

**Clinical Research Coordinator \- Cancer Center \- Clinical Trials Office**

  

**Hiring Department**: Clinical Trials Office


**Location**: Chicago, IL USA


**Requisition ID**: 1042527


**Salary:** The budgeted salary range for this position is $55,000 to $65,000\. Final salary offered will be determined by a thorough assessment of available market data, internal salary equity, candidate experience and qualifications, and budget constraints.


**About the University of Illinois Chicago**


UIC is among the nation’s preeminent urban public research universities, a Carnegie RU/VH research institution, and the largest university in Chicago. UIC serves over 34,000 students, comprising one of the most diverse student bodies in the nation and is designated as a Minority Serving Institution (MSI), an Asian American and Native American Pacific Islander Serving Institution (AANAPSI) and a Hispanic Serving Institution (HSI). Through its 16 colleges, UIC produces nationally and internationally recognized multidisciplinary academic programs in concert with civic, corporate and community partners worldwide, including a full complement of health sciences colleges. By emphasizing cutting\-edge and transformational research along with a commitment to the success of all students, UIC embodies the dynamic, vibrant and engaged urban university. Recent “Best Colleges” rankings published by U.S. News \& World Report, found UIC climbed up in its rankings among top public schools in the nation and among all national universities. UIC has over 300,000 alumni, and is one of the largest employers in the city of Chicago.


This position is intended to be eligible for benefits. This includes Health, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, a Retirement Plan, Paid time Off, and Tuition waivers for employees and dependents.

  

Position Summary
  

This position manages and directs the coordination and timely handling of all components of clinical research protocols, including pre\- and post\-research activities, in and outside of the clinical setting. Responsible for the implementation and conduct of multiple research projects of all clinical phases (I\-IV). Develops and implements effective patient recruitment strategies. Coordinates comprehensive patient protocol treatment schedules to maintain compliance to protocol requirements. Oversees and participates in subject recruitment, screening, scheduling, testing, and data management for multi\-faceted investigation.


Duties \& Responsibilities  

  



* Assist in the establishment and coordinate the implementation of clinical research protocol priorities and organizational structure.


* Notify and inform physicians, clinical staff, affiliates and grant sponsors of adverse events and protocol modifications, including their impact on the clinical research and patients enrolled at UIC.


* Coordinate the activation and maintenance of clinical protocols, including review and completion of submissions, amendments, and adverse event reports as required by the UIC Institutional Review Board (IRB), the National Cancer Institute’s Central IRB, the Cancer Center’s Protocol Review Committee and grant sponsors.


* Review laboratory and clinic procedures sand evaluations regularly that they meet protocol compliance.


* Act as a liaison between physicians, clinical staff and the UIC IRB office, grant sponsors, and regulatory agencies to ensure priorities are clearly communicated and resources are allocated appropriately across multiple ongoing projects.


* Assist physicians and clinical staff in the identification, recruitment and enrollment strategies of patients to increase enrollment and to meet clinical research protocol requirements.


* Execute informed consent process and monitor patient status; enroll patients into research studies, explaining the studies to the patients and their families/loved ones, and obtain/document proper informed consent.


* Ensure that the patient enrollment and research activities comply with the established protocols, regulatory and monitoring agency standards, and grant sponsor guidelines.


* Participate in conducting surveys and quality of life interviews of patients in research protocols.


* Assist investigators in organizing study data for grant progress reports, analyses for meeting presentations and publications.


* Perform other related duties and participates in special projects, as assigned.

  

Minimum Qualifications
  

* Bachelor’s degree in nursing, science, or a health\-related field required.
* Certified Clinical Research Coordinator (CCRC) or Certified Clinical Research Professional certification

preferred and required within 2 years of hire.
  

* At least one year experience in a research discipline required. Experience in a clinical research setting

and experience working with Federal Regulations and IRB’s required; experience with oncology research
  

protocols highly preferred.
  

* Familiarity with medical terminology and procedures including electronic medical records and billing

preferred.
  

* Ability to manage multiple tasks. Strong interpersonal and customer service skills. Requires excellent

written and oral communications, presentation and computer/pc skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and
  

other related software.
  

* Knowledge of Medicare Coverage Analyses and conventional care cost billing, highly desirable.

Experience with Electronic Medical Records, a plus.
  

* Knowledge of research protocols, principles and procedures; knowledge of aspects of clinical trials such

as screening, interviewing, case report forms; knowledge of experimental design, mathematics, statistics,
  

computerized information retrieval systems, and computer data management; ability to identify, produce,
  

organized, evaluate and interpret data; knowledge of ethics and regulatory procedures (e.g., informed
  

consent process, data safety and monitoring plans, principles of data collection and documentation)

 Ability to maintain confidentiality

**The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.**



MedPro Disposal is the nation's largest privately\-held medical waste company, serving 35,000\+ healthcare providers across 48 states for the past 15 years. On that foundation, we launched MP1 Solutions to pioneer the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined healthcare compliance for decades. MP1 Solutions extends MedPro Disposal's operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading — with a technology\-forward approach that's making this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.


**What we do:** We operate as the single compliance partner for non\-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.


**Why it matters:** Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that, backed by 15 years of MedPro Disposal's operational credibility — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.


**Our technology:** We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.


**Our impact:** Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. The Enterprise National Account Manager owns the full\-cycle sales relationship with mid\-market and enterprise healthcare accounts, converting fragmented, incumbent\-vendor compliance arrangements into a single, coordinated MedPro/MP1 partnership. This role exists to grow MedPro's regulated waste and compliance services footprint across multi\-site healthcare organizations by combining disciplined inbound execution with proactive, self\-sourced outbound pipeline\-building. **Required Qualifications:**

* Industry background: Proven ability to manage a complex, multi\-stakeholder sales cycle — identifying decision\-makers and gatekeepers, navigating multi\-site/multi\-location accounts, and closing recurring\-revenue service agreements (not just one\-time transactions); strong outbound/self\-sourcing discipline in addition to working inbound leads

=================================


Must have experience with raw ingredient and distribution sales.

**Job Summary:**


Account Managers are responsible for managing the overall sales efforts in their assigned territory to maximize sales and profit. They must utilize frequent face\-to\-face and/or telephone contact in a consultative sales approach to ensure the satisfaction of customer needs. They must identify selling opportunities and assertively act upon the opportunities that offer maximum potential and/or gross profit \- both with existing customers through cross\- and range\-selling as well as with new leads. They must uphold Brenntag's core values and focus on customer excellence in all regards every day.

**Job Description:**

**Customer Business Development (70%)**

* Meet sales objectives and focus on customer retention as well as improving overall customer satisfaction (also through digital channels).
* Identify customer potentials, i.e., opportunities for cross\- and range\-selling to existing customers and engage relevant stakeholders (e.g., Brenntag Specialties sales staff).
* Set strategies and targets for growth of customers in assigned territory (sales plan); align with Sales Manager.
* Frequently conduct customer visits and prepare the meetings using all available tools and reports, coordinate, negotiate and close proposals.
* Manage spot business/rush offers, get support from Commercial Assistant when necessary.
* Liaise with relevant stakeholders to create in a timely manner the best solution for the customer and extract maximum value (e.g., Sales Management/Product Management for Pricing topics).
* Act as major point of contact to customers in assigned territory in all commercial matters.
* Conduct market studies on potential new product opportunities by contacting customers to gather interest and test market demand.
* Leverage Brenntag Connect to generate and maximize sales.

**New Customer Generation (10%)**

* Spot opportunities for launching sales projects in cooperation with other departments like Product Management.
* Identify and prioritize prospective customers.
* Get in contact with prospects and involve relevant stakeholders to nurture leads down the pipeline.
* Liaise with Brenntag Specialties sales staff on customers with new Brenntag Essentials business opportunities.

**Sales \& General Admin (15%)**

* Set and maximize prices considering value\-based pricing and customer segmentation within guidelines provided by Product Management.
* Ensure appropriate data administration and documentation of all business cases in the local CRM system (e.g., post processing of visits, creation of customer projects).
* Update and maintain customer opportunity pipelines and potentials in the CRM system
* Complete sales and revenue\-related reporting.
* Drive commercial and functional excellence based on guidance/input from Commercial Excellence Function.
* Provide regular forecasts of product demand from customers to Product Management to optimize projected demand requirements.

**Know\-How Management (5% to\-be)**

* Maintain an up\-to\-date level of product knowledge, e.g., via training.
* Keep up to date with changes and updates in the product portfolio and in the market.
* Keep up to date on feedstock and upstream developments that impact product price movements.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Are you looking for limitless career opportunities with a company that values growth, innovation, and teamwork?** At Ntiva, we’re more than a Managed Services Provider, we’re a community dedicated to helping each other, our clients, and their businesses thrive both personally and professionally. Ntiva is a culture of people who are passionate about the work…and each other.



Our clients view us as an essential part of their teams, relying on us for strategic guidance, fast solutions to complex challenges, and proactive support. With strategic locations across the U.S. and leadership from our founder, Steven Freidkin, we’re on the front lines of a fast\-paced industry, facing cybersecurity threats and rapid technology changes together.



If you thrive in a dynamic, supportive environment and enjoy going above and beyond, we’d love to meet you. Come explore one of our many opportunities and grow with us!


**How you will make an impact**



As the Account Manager (AM), you own the client relationship. This is the highest leverage seat in Client Success. Clients trust you to understand their business, connect their technology to where it is going, and make sure Ntiva delivers. You are not a messenger between the client and internal teams. You are the decision bearer in the room. The role is focused on four outcomes: clients who stay because risk was caught early, revenue that grows through disciplined roadmap execution and clean agreements, an expansion pipeline you qualified yourself, and time reclaimed from reactive work and spent on strategy instead.

  


**Location and work expectations**


* Hybrid role in the Chicagoland area, approximately 80% remote and 20% client visits. Allocation may fluctuate based on business needs.
* Must be able to travel by car to client locations, with a valid driver’s license and an insured vehicle.
* Monday through Friday, approximately 8am to 5pm CST.

  


**What you will be doing**


**Own the relationship**


* Own a defined book of business, generally $2M to $2\.5M in annual recurring revenue across approximately 25 to 30 clients, sized by client tier mix and role level.
* Carry the relationship at the executive level. Show up prepared and on time, with an agenda and a written follow\-up summary, and hold the room.
* Run escalations behind the scenes rather than in front of the client, communicate in the language of the client’s business rather than the ticketing system, and maintain a living map of each client’s decision maker, economic buyer, champions, and blockers.


**Drive the strategy**


* Understand how each client makes money, and translate their business objectives into a 12 to 24 month technology roadmap.
* Lead the prescribed engagement cadence for your book of business, including Service Reviews, Strategic Cadences, Technology Business Reviews, and Annual Reviews, leading with the client’s business context rather than a report on Ntiva activity.
* Position new services as answers to a problem you have already diagnosed, and qualify expansion opportunities before engaging solution architect or professional services time.
* Identify at\-risk clients early using defined risk signals, and produce a written save plan before a contract conversation becomes necessary.


**Own the commercials**


* Read and reconcile a client invoice, and explain every line without escalating internally.
* Own renewals end to end: the right mix of services, a current agreement stack, migration off legacy SKUs, and statements of work precise enough that Onboarding can execute without chasing.
* Apply credit discipline as if the margin were your own, recognize when service recovery beats a credit, and use client profitability as an input to account strategy.
* Engage past due clients with clarity and speed, and own your part of accounts receivable tickets end to end with current notes.


**Partner internally**


* Know the services matrix and which team owns which work, including when to engage the solution architect, vCIO, IT Advisor, and Service Delivery, and when not to.
* Qualify work before engaging peer teams, hand off cleanly with confirmation of receipt and an explicit next step, respect peer team process rather than routing around it, and hold peer teams accountable respectfully through a defined path to a defined person.
* Bring client feedback back to Ntiva teams with the diagnostic work done and a solution proposed. Advocacy is not echo. Set client expectations early and hold the line, including saying no, and train clients on how to engage Ntiva.


**Manage your capacity**


* Manage your time so every client receives what they are entitled to, adhere to scheduled block time, and build the week around proactive work rather than inbox reaction.
* Delegate to the right team rather than carrying work by default, push clients toward self\-service where it serves them well, and use approved AI tooling and published documentation for summaries, follow\-up drafting, and routine reconciliation where appropriate.
* Work in ConnectWise Manage fluently across the AM workflow, keep ticket notes current so peer teams see movement without asking, and execute renewals, service additions, and decommissions per process.

  


**How success is defined in this role**


* **CORE values.** Care: outcomes over transactions, and a client who is struggling or unusually quiet is a signal to act on. Ownership: you are accountable from first engagement through renewal, including the fix that prevents a repeat. Responsiveness: you reply within a business day and update proactively. Empathy: you hear the concern before offering the solution.
* **Four behaviors.** Strategic Thinking: technology serves the client’s business goals, and you apply patterns across your portfolio. Proactive Engagement: you surface issues before they escalate and deliver value between formal touchpoints. Internal Advocacy: you represent client interests without damaging relationships with colleague

* A self\-motivated mindset with a desire to learn and grow.

This is an outside sales position responsible for promoting the company's products and services and for building relationships with new and existing accounts. The main focus is to help Sysco customers succeed while achieving sales and profit goals established by the company. This position may require working some non\-traditional hours (evening, weekends, and holidays) to successfully meet customers' needs.

* Ability to read, write, speak English.

* Building Trust
* Building Customer Loyalty
* Follow\-up
* Sales Ability / Persuasiveness
* Managing Work
* Adaptability
* Communication

new_jobs.title: Brownfields Program Coordinator - West
new_jobs.description:
Toeroek Associates, Inc. is seeking a **Brownfields Program Coordinator to** coordinate all phases of Targeted Brownfields Assessments in the western U.S. The successful candidate will provide comprehensive coordination of up to ten concurrent Phase I and II Environmental Site Assessments, supporting a team that assesses the nature and extent of contamination at Brownfields sites.


Periodic travel of up to 25% is required. Worksite locations are distributed across the western United States, including Hawaii and Alaska. Candidates must be geographically located within reasonable proximity of West Coast states in order to support operations and facilitate fieldwork.

**Duties include**

* Provide comprehensive coordination of logistics, staffing, reporting, and deliverables across multiple active sites.
* Oversee project managers, including cost estimates, work schedules, and staff assignments to maintain on\-time and on\-budget performance.
* Provide oversight to field staff and subcontractors conducting site investigation and remediation projects for approximately 15 field sites located in the West region.
* Ensure that project deliverables, milestones, and budgets are met.
* Work closely with senior managers in the coordination of work activities to meet milestones, budgetary limits, deadlines, or other performance indicators.
* Communicate professionally and effectively with government customers and project partners.
* Prepare, review, and submit well\-written technical reports in accordance with regulations, applicable guidance and policies, and internal quality control standards.
* Conduct Phase I and II Environmental Site Assessments (ESAs).
* Lead field activities, including soil, groundwater, sediment, and soil gas sample collection; geological logging and interpretation; and oversight of investigation and remediation subcontractors, including laboratories and excavation and drilling companies
* Support providing soil and groundwater assessments, soil gas sampling, asbestos inspections, lead\-based paint assessments, geophysical surveys, and waste determinations
* Prepare technical reports and other documents on topics associated with site characterization, remedial optimization, and remedy implementation
* Recognize technical discrepancies in analytical results and making appropriate corrections following standard procedures
* Provide support in organizing public meetings to address the findings of ESAs

**Required Education/Experience**


BS degree in Engineering, Geology, Environmental Science, or related field with four years of practical experience related to environmental field sampling and two years as a field\-team lead. Preferred work experience with contaminated site characterization and remediation at contaminated sites, including Superfund, Brownfields, or RCRA Corrective Action sites. Strong knowledge of federal and state environmental laws and regulations under Federal (e.g., Superfund, RCRA, Brownfields), state, or other cleanup programs. Experience with Phase I and Phase II ESAs and experience conducting quantitative analyses using Microsoft Excel

**REQUIRED CREDENTIALS/CERTIFICATIONS:**

* 40\-Hour HAZWOPER

**PROFESSIONAL SKILLS:**

* Demonstrated attributes to become a strong consultant team player, eagerness to learn and grow, self\-starter who takes the initiative, versatile, and service\-oriented
* Effective written/verbal communication and organization/analytical skills; experience writing and compiling technical data and reports
* Ability to multitask, maintain flexibility, travel, and work independently with minimal supervision
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities at once


The anticipated hiring salary range for this remote position is $75,000\-140,000 DOQ. Pay consideration is given based on geographic location, relevant work experience, and education. Toeroek offers a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, Life, LTD, STD, and 401 (k). Qualified applicants should include their resume with their completed application for further consideration.

Toeroek offers a collaborative and congenial work environment with a team of passionate staff dedicated to finding solutions to complex problems in the fields of environment, records and knowledge management, and national security. Our multi\-disciplined environmental staff includes scientific, legal, and engineering experts who support federal and state government entities in compliance, removal and remediation, field services, site assessments, oversight, historical and technical research, litigation, cost recovery, and community engagement.

Our Builds division creates **brand activations**, **trade show booths**, **custom furniture**, and **specialty fabrication** for clients nationwide, with a strong base in Los Angeles and Orange County.

Role Overview

You’ll own the sales process from first response through close, working closely with engineering/design and the shop team to scope projects, create proposals, and win orders.

This role is **salary \+ quarterly performance bonuses**.

* Trade show booths and exhibit builds (including installations)

Qualifications

new_jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
The mission of The Los Angeles Cancer Network is to provide unparalleled care to each patient that comes through our doors. We offer individualized treatment using the most recent and relevant proven advances in cancer care, curated with deliberation and compassion. LACN is committed to educating and supporting our patients and their families through every step of the way. We deliver a unique approach for every patient to ensure they receive treatment best suited to their condition, age, and other important factors. We do this by participating in important clinical research, encouraging screenings for early detection, and providing innovative treatment. We are proud to be at the forefront of cancer research through our partnership with OneOncology.


Why Join Us? We are looking for talented and highly\-motivated individuals who demonstrate a natural desire to support the meaningful work of community oncologists and the patients we serve.

**Job Description:**


The **Clinical Research Coordinator** works independently providing study coordination including screening of potential patients for protocol eligibility, presenting non\-medical trial concepts and details, and participating in the informed consent process. Responsible for accurate and timely source documents, data collection, documentation, entry, and reporting including timely response to sponsor queries. Responsible for compiling and reporting on each study including information related to protocol activity, accrual data, workload, and other research information; present this information at regular research staff meetings. May plan and coordinate strategies for increasing patient enrollment, improving efficiency, training of personnel, or identifying new research opportunities. Ensures compliance with all federal and local agencies including the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and local Institutional Review Board (IRB).

**Essential Functions:**


The following reflects management’s definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time with reasonable accommodations.

* Independent study coordination including screening of potential patients for protocol eligibility, presenting non\-medical trial concepts and details to the patients, and participating in the informed consent process.
* Scheduling of patients for research visits and procedures.
* In collaboration with the physician and other medical personnel, documents thoroughly on Case Report Forms (CRFs) the following: changes in patient condition, adverse events, concomitant medication use, protocol compliance, response to study drug.
* Maintains accurate source documents related to all research procedures.
* Responsible for accurate and timely data collection, documentation, entry, and reporting including timely response to sponsor queries.
* Schedules and participates in monitoring and auditing activities.
* Responsible for compiling and reporting on each study including information related to protocol activity, accrual data, workload, and other research information; present this information at regular research staff meetings.
* Notifies direct supervisor about concerns regarding data quality and study conduct.
* Works closely with a regulatory coordinator or directly with the Institutional Review Board (IRB) to submit Adverse Events, Serious Adverse Events, protocol deviations, and Safety Letters in accordance with local and federal guidelines.
* May involve in assisting with patient research billing and reconciliation.
* Ensures compliance with all federal and local agencies including the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and local Institutional Review Board.
* Maintains research practices using Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines.
* Maintains strict patient confidentiality according to HIPAA regulations and applicable law.
* May coordinate training and education of other personnel.
* May participate in centralized activities such as auditing, Standard Operating Procedure development, etc.
* Responsible to plan and coordinate strategies for increasing patient enrollment, and/or improving clinical research efficiency.
* May identify quality and performance improvement opportunities and collaborate with staff in the development of action plans to improve quality.
* May identify new research opportunities and present to investigators
* Participates in required training and education programs.

**Key Competencies:**

* Strong customer service background, preferably in a healthcare setting.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Knowledge of computer/telephone support, preferably in the healthcare industry.
* Ability to resolve customer issues calmly and professionally with diplomacy and tact.

**Education and Experience:**

* BA/BS Degree – Preferred.
* ACRP/SoCRA (or equivalent) certification preferred.
* 1 year minimum of clinical research coordination experience, required
* Previous Oncology/Hematology experience preferred.

**Additional Requirements:**

* Great Customer Service Skills.
* Knowledge of medical terminology, specifically in Oncology/Hematology.
* Able to travel to satellite clinics when necessary.
* Must be willing and able to lift up to 25 pounds.

**Compensation:**

* Pay range from $75k to $80k, depending on experience and education.

new_jobs.description:
**Executive Assistant to Founder \& CEO**

**Trauma Law \| Los Angeles, CAFull\-Time \| In Office$85,000 to $150,000, depending on experience**

Trauma Law is looking for an exceptional Executive Assistant to work directly with our Founder and CEO.

This is not an entry\-level administrative position.

We are looking for someone who has supported a CEO, founder, law firm owner, entrepreneur, or other high\-level executive and understands what great executive support actually looks like.

The right person does not wait to be told what to do.

You anticipate. You organize. You protect time. You follow through. You remember the details everyone else forgot. You make sure priorities do not get buried by interruptions.

Most importantly, you make the person you support better.

**THE ROLE**

Your job is to help our Founder operate at the highest possible level.

That means keeping priorities moving, protecting her calendar, preparing her for meetings, organizing information, coordinating follow\-up, eliminating unnecessary distractions, and making sure important commitments do not fall through the cracks.

You will work closely with our Director of Operations and leadership team, but your primary responsibility is the effectiveness of the Founder.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

* Manage a complex and constantly changing executive calendar
* Protect the Founder's time and ensure her schedule reflects the firm's highest priorities
* Prepare daily and weekly executive priority lists
* Prepare the Founder for meetings with the information, documents, deadlines, names, and background she needs before walking into the room
* Manage scheduling, confirmations, changes, travel, reservations, and executive logistics
* Review and organize communications so important issues rise quickly and routine noise does not
* Track commitments made during meetings and conversations and ensure follow\-up occurs
* Coordinate with attorneys, executives, employees, vendors, doctors, experts, referral partners, and other high\-level contacts
* Draft correspondence and organize documents for executive review
* Maintain extreme confidentiality regarding business, employees, clients, finances, and sensitive matters
* Anticipate conflicts and problems before they reach the Founder
* Know what requires the Founder's attention and what does not
* Keep a running list of decisions, priorities, outstanding items, and follow\-ups
* Make sure nothing important disappears because the day got busy

**YOU MAY BE THE RIGHT PERSON IF**

* You have supported a CEO, founder, entrepreneur, managing partner, or senior executive before.
* You are extraordinarily organized.
* You notice details other people miss.
* You have excellent judgment.
* You can walk into a fast\-moving environment and quickly determine what matters most.
* You are comfortable dealing with strong, successful personalities.
* You are confident enough to respectfully say, "You have three things competing for that hour. Which one wins?"
* You are proactive without becoming intrusive.
* You communicate clearly and briefly.
* You follow through relentlessly.
* You can handle confidential information without drama, gossip, or loose conversation.
* You are comfortable when priorities change.
* You do not become overwhelmed when ten things happen at once.
* And you take enormous pride in being the person who makes everything run.

**REQUIRED**

* 5\+ years of professional administrative or executive support experience
* Significant experience directly supporting a CEO, founder, owner, C\-suite executive, managing partner, or equivalent senior leader
* Exceptional calendar management and organizational skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Strong Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, Teams, and general technology skills
* Ability to handle highly confidential information
* Excellent professional judgment
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to work independently and make decisions without constant supervision
* Ability to work in person in our Los Angeles area office
* Law firm experience is helpful but not required.
* High\-level executive support experience is required.

**THIS ROLE IS PROBABLY NOT FOR YOU IF**

* You need every task assigned to you.
* You frequently say, "No one told me."
* You are uncomfortable with changing priorities.
* You need a predictable day where everything happens exactly as scheduled.
* You consider calendar management to simply mean accepting meeting invitations.
* You wait for problems to become urgent before addressing them.
* You are looking for a traditional administrative assistant position.
* This is executive support at a high level.

**ABOUT TRAUMA LAW**

The CUNY Fatherhood Academy (CFA) is a comprehensive program designed to promote responsible parenting and to foster economic stability for unemployed and underemployed young fathers through education, employment, and personal development. The program’s central focus is to help young fathers prepare for and enroll into college or training programs, with the understanding that earning a college degree is the most effective path toward providing long\-term economic sustainability for themselves and their families. new_jobs.title: Social Media Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Outtake**
=================


Outtake exists to empower and facilitate trust for a digital\-first world. Today, impersonation, fraud, AI\-driven scams, and identity abuse spread faster than any security team can respond to. So we built something different: an agentic AI platform that proactively detects, monitors, and takes down impersonators, automating protection in hours, not weeks.

  

Built by ex\-Palantir, ex\-CTO/founders, and ex\-Notion engineers, Outtake is designed for clarity, autonomy, and velocity. Our goal is ambitious: become the trust layer of the modern internet. And we intend to do it with a lean, dense, exceptionally talented team.

  

Outtake is backed by top\-tier investors and operators who believe in our mission and our model. With strong financial footing and a long runway, we prioritize creating an environment where people can do the best work of their careers.

**The Role**
============


Outtake is looking for a Social Media Manager. You will own and grow Outtake's presence across LinkedIn and X, developing the strategy, building the editorial calendar, creating and publishing content, engaging with the audience, and tracking performance. You will have meaningful autonomy and will be expected to take a broad brief and turn it into a consistent stream of relevant, high\-quality content.


You will operate as a small, self\-directed content studio inside Outtake. Rather than waiting for assignments, you will proactively find stories across the company, spend time with employees and customers, and turn what you learn into timely, platform\-native content — working closely with the CEO to understand and sharpen Outtake's voice, then translate it consistently across the company's social channels.


This is a role that requires immersion in the conversation. You will immerse yourself in cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, online trust, identity, fraud, and the wider conversations shaping the internet, identifying where Outtake can contribute something timely and distinctive and finding compelling ways to bring the company into those conversations.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Own Outtake's company accounts across LinkedIn and X, from strategy and planning through publishing and performance analysis.
* Learn Outtake's product, customers, market, and point of view deeply enough to create content with limited oversight.
* Build your own content pipeline by proactively identifying interesting people, customer stories, product developments, and moments worth sharing.
* Interview employees and customers to uncover insights, stories, and perspectives that can become compelling social content.
* Turn interviews, conversations, and emerging ideas into posts, clips, graphics, and recurring content formats quickly.
* Identify emerging topics, news cycles, and online discussions where Outtake has a credible and interesting perspective.
* Create lightweight visual content, simple graphics, carousels, screenshots, and short\-form video edits to support social storytelling.
* Track audience growth, engagement, brand relevance, website traffic, and downstream business impact.
* As the content function matures, we expect this role to take on broader ownership over Outtake's editorial voice and content strategy.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* Demonstrated ability to create strong social content, whether through professional work, independent projects, or a compelling personal portfolio.
* The judgment to participate in timely conversations without sounding forced, opportunistic, or disconnected from the brand.
* Comfort owning a process independently, making decisions with incomplete information, and moving work forward without extensive oversight.
* The resourcefulness to take an idea from concept to finished post using the tools and support available.
* Experience creating lightweight visual assets and making quick video or image edits.
* Comfort using analytics to evaluate performance, identify patterns, and make informed creative decisions.
* Cybersecurity or AI experience is not required — we care more about your ability to learn quickly, develop informed perspectives, and turn complex ideas into content people want to engage with.

**Life at Outtake**
===================

* **Office:** For those in NY, we are an in\-person team (5 days a week, with flexibility as needed) working out of a stunning waterfront office in Brooklyn. Collaboration, speed, and clarity matter.
* **Health:** 100% company\-paid medical, dental, and vision for employees.
* **Time Away:** Flexible PTO. We trust adults to manage energy, not clock time.
* **Culture \& Team:** Annual company retreats and regular in\-person events.


Outtake is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team.


Compensation Range: $85K \- $95K

The $250B insurance claims industry runs on fax machines, phone tag, and adjusters buried in paperwork. Cycle times stretch for months. Data is locked in legacy systems. And the workforce is aging out faster than it's being replaced.


Vega is the premier AI\-native claims TPA built to replace that entire stack. Our team is equal parts experienced insurance operators and modern technologists. We care deeply about delivering superior outcomes for our clients, and we want builders that get their hands dirty shipping solutions that move the needle.

You'll sit on the People team, splitting your time between recruiting coordination and employee experience — scheduling interviews and running a great onsite candidate experience, keeping our office and employee events running smoothly, and supporting new hires as they onboard.


This is a highly in\-person role: you'll be in our New York office four days a week, and you'll be the person who makes the day\-to\-day experience — for candidates, new hires, and the team — feel organized, warm, and well run.


You'll do well here if you like variety, don't mind switching gears a few times a day, and take real pride in the small things that make an office, hiring \& people processes, feel well run. Bonus points if you're already using AI in your day\-to\-day and are eager to find smarter, more efficient ways to run our tools and workflows.

**PI and Referral Operations Coordinator**

We are an outpatient diagnostic imaging center serving patients, attorneys, medical practices, referral networks, and Workers' Compensation partners throughout Metro Atlanta.

We are seeking an organized and proactive PI and Referral Operations Coordinator to manage the operational workflow for personal\-injury, attorney, One Call, Workers' Compensation, insurance, and other external referrals.

This position is responsible for referral tracking, attorney and referral\-partner communication, LOP documentation coordination, authorization follow\-up, appointment coordination, and preparing completed cases for handoff to the billing department.

This is not a medical billing position. The role works closely with our biller, but billing, claims, denials, payments, and collections remain with the billing department.

Spanish\-speaking ability is strongly preferred but not required.

**What you will do**

\- Receive and track personal\-injury, attorney, One Call, Workers' Compensation, insurance, and other external referrals  
\- Maintain an accurate referral tracker with case status, missing information, next action, owner, and follow\-up date  
\- Communicate professionally with attorneys, law offices, clinics, referral coordinators, case managers, and network partners  
\- Confirm that referrals include the required patient, study, order, diagnosis, authorization, and contact information  
\- Track Letters of Protection and related documentation  
\- Request missing LOP documents and route completed packets for management review  
\- Track whether an LOP has been approved, is pending, needs revision, or has been declined  
\- Coordinate with the Patient Access and Imaging Coordinator to schedule patients once the referral is ready  
\- Track prior authorization status when authorization is required  
\- Follow up with referring offices, attorneys, payers, and referral partners regarding missing or delayed information  
\- Track Workers' Compensation information such as claim details, employer information, adjuster information, and authorization status  
\- Coordinate One Call and other referral\-network workflows  
\- Monitor open referrals and identify cases that have stalled  
\- Provide appointment and referral\-status updates to authorized referral sources  
\- Confirm when studies have been completed  
\- Assemble complete front\-end information for the billing department  
\- Route completed cases to the biller with the appropriate order, diagnosis, authorization, LOP, referral, and payer information  
\- Track cases that are waiting for billing handoff or additional documentation  
\- Maintain organized email records, referral notes, and case documentation  
\- Prepare referral\-status and aging reports for management  
\- Escalate legal, financial, clinical, or payer exceptions to the appropriate person  
\- Protect patient privacy and follow HIPAA and Georgia Health Imaging procedures

**What this role does not own**

This position coordinates the referral and documentation workflow but does not independently:

\- Approve or negotiate Letters of Protection  
\- Change legal or financial terms  
\- Provide legal advice  
\- Negotiate referral contracts or reimbursement rates  
\- Submit or correct claims  
\- Perform medical coding  
\- Manage denials  
\- Post payments or ERAs  
\- Handle collections  
\- Approve discounts or write\-offs  
\- Make clinical decisions  
\- Determine MRI protocols or contrast requirements  
\- Provide clinical interpretations  
\- Administer PACS, VPN, DICOM, or network systems
